example: The palace where the last emperor lived is now a museum that attracts millions of visitors each year. (最後一位皇帝住過的宮殿，如今是一座每年吸引數百萬遊客的博物館。)
Before approving the final design, the engineer demanded an exact measurement of every steel beam in the bridge. (在核准最終設計前，工程師要求精確測量橋梁的每一根鋼梁。)

meaning: adj. 傳統的；慣例的；口耳相傳的
example: Although the town now attracts thousands of tourists, its traditional houses are still occupied by local families who refuse to sell. (雖然這座小鎮現在每年吸引數千名遊客，傳統房舍仍由不願出售的當地家庭居住。)
Patients in rural clinics often lack access to specialists, so many travel for hours to see a doctor. (鄉間診所的病人往往缺乏專科醫師資源，因此許多人得花好幾個小時車程才能看診。)

meaning: int. （請對方再說一遍）什麼 n./v. 原諒；寬恕；赦免
example: The mayor asked residents to pardon the noise, explaining that the road repairs could not wait until spring. (市長請居民原諒施工噪音，並說明道路維修無法等到春天才動工。)
When the young king was still a child, his uncle ruled the country as regent for six years. (年幼的國王還是個孩子時，他的叔叔以攝政者身分治理國家六年。)

meaning: vi. 迅速成長；發展 n. 嫩芽
example: Online tutoring began to burgeon after parents realised that the daily travel time to city centres could be avoided. (家長發現可以省下每天前往市區的通勤時間後，線上家教開始迅速成長。)
Some doctors argue that hospitals should offer free evening appointments so that workers need not take unpaid leave. (有些醫師主張，醫院應提供免費的夜間門診，讓勞工不必請無薪假。)
The village library barely has enough working computers, yet teenagers queue there every afternoon to finish their homework. (村裡的圖書館幾乎沒有足夠堪用的電腦，但青少年每天下午仍排隊到那裡寫功課。)
Rice fields flooded for long periods release methane, so farmers are experimenting with methods that use less water. (長期淹水的稻田會釋放甲烷，因此農民正實驗用水較少的方法。)

meaning: n. 階層；等級制度；領導層
example: In many companies the old hierarchy is giving way to flatter teams that make decisions faster. (在許多公司裡，舊有的階層體制正被決策更快的扁平化團隊取代。)
Without clear guidance from staff, visitors to the new gallery often miss the most important paintings on the upper floor. (沒有工作人員清楚的指引，參觀新美術館的遊客常錯過樓上最重要的畫作。)
Our host was so easy-going that he let us change our travel plans three times without ever complaining. (我們的主人非常隨和，讓我們三度更改旅遊計畫也毫無怨言。)
The old electrical system of the train failed near the tunnel, leaving passengers in darkness for twenty minutes. (火車老舊的電力系統在隧道附近故障，讓乘客在黑暗中待了二十分鐘。)
Doctors can now share electronic records between clinics, which reduces the need for patients to repeat the same tests. (醫師現在能在各診所之間共享電子病歷，減少病人重複做相同檢查的需要。)
Roll film is still used by hobbyists who enjoy the slow, careful process of analogue photography. (底片仍被喜歡慢工細活的類比攝影愛好者使用。)
His philosophy is simple: work hard, stay curious, and never stop asking questions. (他的處世哲理很簡單：努力工作、保持好奇，永遠不要停止提問。)
Millions of office workers suffer from chronic back pain caused by sitting for too long. (數百萬名上班族因久坐而飽受慢性背痛之苦。)

meaning: adj. 值得擁有的；合意的；可取的
example: A quiet neighbourhood with good schools is highly desirable for families with young children. (環境安靜、學校辦學良好的社區，對有幼童的家庭來說非常理想。)

meaning: n. 財團；聯營企業；協會
example: A consortium of engineering firms will build the offshore wind farm, although local fishermen still oppose the plan. (一個工程公司組成的財團將興建離岸風場，儘管當地漁民仍反對這項計畫。)

meaning: n. 皮帶扣環 v. 扣緊；（使）變形；彎曲
example: Passengers are told to buckle their seat belts before the plane begins to move. (乘客被告知在飛機開始移動前要扣緊安全帶。)

meaning: n. 咖哩；咖哩菜餚 vt. 做成咖哩；梳刷（馬毛）
example: She learned to cook a spicy Thai curry while volunteering at a village school in Asia. (她在亞洲一所村落學校擔任志工時，學會煮香辣的泰式咖哩。)

meaning: adj. 下意識的；潛意識的
example: Advertisers are accused of using subliminal images to make viewers want products they do not need. (廣告商被指控用下意識的影像，讓觀眾想買他們其實不需要的產品。)
The upper chamber unexpectedly rejected the housing bill, arguing that it would raise rents in smaller coastal towns. (上議院意外否決了住宅法案，主張該法案會推高較小沿海城鎮的租金。)
Frequent hand washing still remains one of the simplest ways to stop infections spreading through a busy household. (勤洗手依然是防止感染在繁忙家庭中散播的最簡單方法之一。)

meaning: adj. 繁榮的；興旺的；成功的
example: The once quiet town became prosperous after its university attracted technology companies and young families from the capital. (這座原本安靜的小鎮，在大學吸引科技公司和首都年輕家庭進駐後變得繁榮。)

meaning: n. 目的；意圖；用途 v. 打算；企圖
example: The purpose of the meeting was to agree on a timetable for repairs rather than to discuss costs. (這場會議的目的是敲定維修時程，而不是討論費用。)
The festival offers a variety of performances, from street acrobatics to quiet readings in the small local library. (這個節慶提供各式各樣的表演，從街頭特技到當地圖書館裡的靜態朗讀都有。)
Rapid immigration has changed the character of the neighbourhood, bringing new shops and languages to its main street. (移民快速湧入，改變了這個社區的風貌，為主要街道帶來新的商店和語言。)

meaning: adj. 自然的；天然的；天賦的
example: Family doctors now recommend natural remedies only when scientific evidence shows that they are truly safe and effective. (家庭醫師現在只有在科學證據顯示真正安全有效時，才會建議使用自然療法。)

meaning: v. 打賭；敢說 n. 賭注；打賭
example: I would bet that most passengers would support a later train service, even if tickets cost slightly more. (我敢說大多數乘客會支持加開晚班列車，即使票價稍微貴一點。)
Consumer confidence fell sharply after news of rising electricity prices quickly spread across the region. (電價上漲的消息在各地迅速傳開後，消費者信心大幅下滑。)
Her family physician advised her to cut down on salt and walk for half an hour daily. (她的家庭醫師建議她減少鹽分攝取，每天走路半小時。)

meaning: adj. 相等的；平等的 vt. 比得上；等於
example: The law requires that men and women receive equal pay for work of the same value. (法律要求男女從事同等價值的工作時，應獲得同等的報酬。)

meaning: n. 度假勝地；憑藉 vi. 訴諸；求助
example: The mountain resort now makes artificial snow because winters have become shorter and less predictable in recent years. (這座山區度假勝地現在必須人造雪，因為近年冬天變得更短、更難預測。)

meaning: n. 領導；領導層；領導能力
example: Strong leadership at the school helped teachers adapt to online lessons without losing contact with their students during the crisis. (危機期間，校方強有力的領導幫助教師適應線上教學，同時沒有和學生失去聯繫。)
Campaigners demand greater equity in public bus services, arguing that rural residents pay even more for fewer routes. (倡議人士要求公共巴士服務更公平，主張鄉村居民付得更多、路線卻更少。)
Workers will excavate the busy road for several weeks before the new water pipes can finally be laid. (工人將開挖這條繁忙道路好幾個星期，之後新水管才能終於鋪設完成。)

meaning: adj. 核能的；原子核的；核武器的
example: The debate over nuclear power has bitterly divided the country ever since the old coastal plant was closed. (自從那座老舊的沿海核電廠關閉後，核能爭議就讓全國陷入嚴重對立。)
The two firms ended their dispute and signed an agreement based on mutual trust. (兩家公司結束爭議，簽下一份建立在相互信任之上的協議。)
The council bought forty hectares of farmland to create a wetland that will protect the town from flooding. (市議會買下四十公頃農地，打造能保護小鎮免於淹水的濕地。)
High population density in the old district makes it hard to build new parking spaces. (舊城區人口密度高，使得增建停車位相當困難。)

meaning: adj. 巨大的；大量的；大規模的
example: A massive increase in online shopping has forced retailers to rethink their delivery systems. (網購大幅成長，迫使零售業者重新思考配送系統。)
Colleagues gathered to congratulate her on winning a national award for urban design. (同事們齊聚一堂，祝賀她贏得全國都市設計獎。)
For many elderly people, a dog is a loyal companion that keeps loneliness away. (對許多長者而言，狗是忠實的同伴，能趕走寂寞。)

meaning: vt. 操縱；壟斷 n. 成套設備；鑽井架
example: Investigators discovered that traders had tried to rig the price of electricity. (調查人員發現，交易員曾試圖操縱電價。)

meaning: n. 投入；輸入；輸入的資料 vt. 輸入（電腦）
example: Senior teachers were asked for their input before the school replaced printed textbooks with tablets in every classroom. (學校在全面以平板電腦取代紙本教科書之前，先徵詢了資深教師的意見。)
Faster phones are merely one part of the solution, since reliable networks matter far more in remote mountain areas. (手機速度更快只是解決方案的一部分，因為在偏遠山區，穩定的網路重要得多。)
Experienced nurses impart practical skills to trainees during long shifts in the ward. (資深護理師在病房長時間值班時，把實務技能傳授給實習生。)

meaning: v. 喪失；被沒收 n. 罰款；代價
example: Tenants who ignore repeated warnings about late-night noise may forfeit the right to renew their lease next year. (忽視深夜噪音多次警告的房客，可能會喪失明年續租的權利。)
Cutting soft drinks is one of the easiest ways to reduce the calories you drink each day. (戒掉含糖飲料，是減少每天喝進卡路里最簡單的方法之一。)
Small shops in the mountains receive their goods by van on a winding road. (山區的小店靠廂型車在蜿蜒的山路上送貨。)
Poor ventilation in older apartments can cause damp walls and breathing problems. (老舊公寓通風不良，可能造成牆壁潮濕和呼吸問題。)
She moved from the beginner group to an intermediate swimming class after practising every morning for a month. (她每天早上練習一個月後，從初級班升上中級游泳班。)
The painting suggests that the cycle of nature is eternal, beyond human control. (這幅畫暗示大自然的循環是永恆的，超乎人為掌控。)
The museum's new gallery explores the invasion of the coastal town and the long period of rebuilding that followed. (博物館的新展廳探討這座沿海小鎮遭入侵的經過，以及隨後漫長的重建期。)

meaning: adv. 然而；不過 conj. 然而
example: The plan is expensive; nevertheless, most residents agree that the new bridge is necessary. (這項計畫所費不貲；然而，多數居民都同意新橋是必要的。)
Fans celebrated the team's unexpected promotion by filling the square, though the players had already left for home. (球迷擠滿廣場慶祝球隊意外升格，不過球員早已返家。)

meaning: adj. 鼓舞人心的；啟發靈感的
example: The teacher's inspiring lessons persuaded several shy students to study engineering at university despite the difficult entrance exams. (這位老師鼓舞人心的課程，說服了幾位害羞的學生不畏困難的入學考試，攻讀大學工程系。)

meaning: n. 出席；出席人數；照料
example: Attendance at local matches has risen sharply since the club lowered ticket prices for families with young children. (自從球團調降帶幼童家庭的票價後，地方賽事的出席人數便上升了。)

meaning: adj. 可選擇的；非強制的
example: The museum tour is optional, but visitors who join it usually notice small details they would otherwise miss. (博物館導覽並非強制參加，但參加的遊客通常會注意到原本可能錯過的小細節。)

meaning: vt. 使能夠；使成為可能
example: A simple text reminder can enable patients to remember their medication even when their busy daily routine changes. (簡單的簡訊提醒能讓病人即使在忙碌的日常作息改變時，仍記得服藥。)
A short departmental meeting every Monday helps staff share complaints that customers have raised during the busy weekend. (每週一簡短的部門會議，能讓員工分享顧客在繁忙週末提出的抱怨。)
The wound will heal faster if you keep it clean and avoid heavy lifting. (如果你保持傷口清潔、避免提重物，傷口會癒合得更快。)
Engineers will dismantle the old turbine piece by piece, then carefully transport the metal to a recycling plant. (工程師將把舊渦輪機逐一拆解，再小心地把金屬運往回收廠。)
Farm workers demanded a higher minimum wage because living costs had risen sharply. (農工要求提高最低工資，因為生活成本已大幅上漲。)

meaning: n. 風景；地貌 vt. 景觀美化
example: Wind farms have changed the landscape of this coastal region within a decade. (風力發電場在十年內改變了這個沿海地區的地貌。)
Her voice showed little emotion as she read the letter, though everyone knew how much the news meant. (她讀信時聲音幾乎沒有情感，但大家都知道這消息對她意義重大。)

meaning: n. 聯邦；共同體；（the C-）大英國協
example: Students from across the Commonwealth compete for a small number of research scholarships. (來自大英國協各國的學生，角逐為數不多的研究獎學金。)
The residents' newsletter now includes air-quality figures, so neighbours can see whether the new traffic rules really help. (社區電子報現在會刊載空氣品質數據，讓鄰居了解新交通規定是否真能改善問題。)

meaning: n. 期刊 adj. 週期的；定期的
example: The doctor cited a medical periodical published last month to explain why the clinic changed its official advice. (醫師引用上個月出版的醫學期刊，說明診所為何改變官方建議。)
The hotel receptionist found us a room at another nearby guesthouse after a pipe burst and flooded ours. (水管爆裂淹了我們的房間後，飯店櫃檯人員幫我們在附近另一家民宿找到住處。)

meaning: n. 安全；保障；保安；證券
example: The large company increased digital security after hackers obtained customers' personal addresses, but many users still feel unprotected. (這家大公司在駭客取得顧客個人地址後加強數位安全，但許多使用者仍覺得沒有保障。)

meaning: n. 夾子；迴紋針；片段 v. 夾住；修剪
example: A short clip of the interview went viral and was shared thousands of times. (那段採訪的短片在網路上爆紅，被分享了好幾千次。)
Forest loss continues apace despite strict new laws, because illegal logging is still rarely punished in remote districts. (儘管有嚴格的新法，森林流失仍快速持續，因為偏遠地區的非法伐木鮮少受到懲罰。)

meaning: n. 產量；收益 v. 出產；屈服
example: Farmers reported a lower yield this season because the spring rains arrived too late. (農民表示本季產量偏低，因為春雨來得太晚。)

meaning: adj. 公平的；公正的 n. 園遊會；博覽會
example: The local club promised a fair selection process after parents complained that places always went to wealthier families. (在家長抱怨名額總是落入較富裕家庭後，這家地方俱樂部承諾選拔過程會公平。)
The regional hospital will close its maternity unit next year, forcing expectant mothers to travel to the city. (這家區域醫院明年將關閉婦產科病房，迫使準媽媽們前往市區就醫。)

meaning: adj. 安全的；可靠的 v. 獲得；保護
example: Many older tenants feel less secure because their rents can rise much faster than their pensions, especially in city centres. (許多較年長的房客覺得較沒有保障，因為房租上漲速度可能遠快於退休金，尤其是在市中心。)

meaning: vt. 保護；保存；維持；醃漬
example: Local groups are working to preserve the old market before developers buy the land. (在開發商買下這塊地之前，地方團體正努力保存這座老市場。)

meaning: vt. 拒絕；摒棄 n. 不合格品
example: The council rejected the plan because it would have destroyed a protected wetland. (市議會拒絕了這項計畫，因為它會破壞一片受保護的濕地。)

meaning: n. 密碼；程式碼；法規 vt. 編碼
example: New buildings must follow a strict energy code that limits heat loss in winter. (新建築必須遵守嚴格的能源法規，以限制冬季的熱能流失。)
Hundreds of graduates seek internships abroad to gain experience they cannot get at home. (數百名畢業生尋求海外實習機會，以取得在國內得不到的經驗。)
The last item on our packing list was a small torch, which proved useful when the power failed. (我們打包清單上的最後一項是一支小手電筒，停電時正好派上用場。)

meaning: n. 王冠；齒冠 vt. 為……加冕
example: The crown used at the ceremony is only a copy; the original remains locked in an old basement. (典禮上使用的王冠只是複製品，真品仍鎖在一間老舊的地下室裡。)
Losing weight requires sustained effort, yet small changes in daily habits often matter more than strict diets alone. (減重需要持續努力，但日常習慣的小改變往往比單靠嚴格節食更重要。)

meaning: n. 要點；論點；分數；尖端 v. 指向；表明
example: Her point about flexible hours was quietly accepted, although managers worried that some teams might abuse the system. (她關於彈性工時的論點被默默接受了，儘管主管擔心有些團隊可能濫用制度。)

meaning: n. 回顧；評論；複習 vt. 回顧；評論
example: The restaurant received a poor review in the local paper, yet it still remained fully booked for weeks. (這家餐廳在地方報紙得到負評，卻仍連續數週訂位全滿。)
The committee treated the claim as a complete fabrication because no written document supported the witness's detailed account. (委員會認為這項說法完全是捏造，因為沒有書面文件支持證人的詳細陳述。)
A series of small delays made the journey frustrating, though the train eventually arrived only ten minutes late. (一連串小延誤讓旅程令人煩躁，不過火車最後只晚了十分鐘抵達。)

meaning: n. 變化；變動；變種；變奏
example: There is wide variation in class sizes across the district, which makes it hard to compare test results fairly. (這個學區各校班級人數差異很大，因此很難公平比較測驗結果。)

meaning: n. 邊緣；頁邊空白；差額；餘地
example: The home team still won by a narrow margin, despite missing two of their best players through injury. (地主隊雖然有兩名最佳球員因傷缺陣，仍以些微差距獲勝。)

meaning: n. 分心的事；娛樂；消遣
example: Chatty classmates can be a serious distraction, so the teacher now moves quiet students to the front of the room. (愛講話的同學可能造成嚴重分心，因此老師現在把安靜的學生調到前排。)
A missing stamp on the application form complicated the visa process and delayed our family's departure by a week. (申請表上少了一個印章讓簽證流程變複雜，也讓我們全家出發時間延後一週。)

meaning: n. 路面電車；有軌電車
example: The old tram was slower than the bus, but it carried far more passengers during the morning rush. (舊路面電車比公車慢，但在早上尖峰時段載運的乘客多得多。)
The course encourages maturity by asking teenagers to manage a small weekly budget and explain their choices carefully. (這門課要求青少年管理每週預算並仔細說明選擇，藉此培養成熟度。)
Visitors can download a free audio guide before walking around the main exhibition, which keeps the galleries quiet. (參觀者可以在走訪主展覽前下載免費語音導覽，讓展廳保持安靜。)

meaning: v. 參考；提到；引用；轉介
example: The new report refers to rapidly falling birth rates but says little about how local schools should respond. (這份新報告提到生育率快速下降，卻很少談到地方學校該如何因應。)

meaning: n. 面試；採訪 v. 面試；採訪
example: The recorded interview lasted an hour, yet the journalist published only two brief sentences from the entire conversation. (錄音訪談進行了一小時，記者卻只刊登整段對話中的兩個簡短句子。)
Scientists are still debating the extent to which rising sea temperatures seriously threaten shallow tropical coral reefs worldwide. (科學家仍在爭論海水升溫究竟在多大程度上嚴重威脅全球淺海熱帶珊瑚礁。)
Rescuers had to evacuate the whole street after a gas pipe began leaking. (瓦斯管開始漏氣後，救援人員必須疏散整條街的居民。)

meaning: n. 任期；一段時間；限額
example: After a two-year stint as a manager abroad, he returned home to start his own business. (在國外擔任經理兩年之後，他返鄉創立自己的事業。)
The railway embankment collapsed after weeks of heavy rain, so local replacement buses ran for the entire month. (鐵路堤岸在大雨連下數週後崩塌，因此當地接駁巴士整整行駛了一個月。)

meaning: v. 壓扁；擠壓；塞入 n. 壁球
example: Please do not squash the tomatoes at the bottom of the shopping bag. (請不要把購物袋底部的番茄壓扁。)
The federation of small farmers negotiates prices with supermarkets on behalf of its members. (這個小農聯合會代表會員與超市協商價格。)

meaning: v. 蜂擁而出；湧動 n. 猛增；湧動
example: A sudden surge in winter flu cases forced the hospital to cancel all routine operations for two weeks. (冬季流感病例突然猛增，迫使醫院取消所有例行手術兩週。)

meaning: adj. 身體的；物理的；物質的 n. 體檢
example: Teachers report that daily physical activity before lessons helps young pupils concentrate, especially during the long afternoon sessions. (教師表示，上課前的每日身體活動能幫助年幼學生專心，尤其是在漫長的下午課程中。)
The company struggled to justify the high fares to passengers who had no alternative route. (這家公司難以向沒有其他路線可選的乘客，證明高票價是合理的。)

meaning: n. 得分；分數；樂譜 v. 得分；評分
example: His score improved after he changed his grip, though he still lost the final match by two points. (他改變握拍方式後分數進步了，不過仍在決賽以兩分之差落敗。)
Leaflets alone rarely persuade people to give up smoking; close support from family and friends often matters far more. (單靠傳單很少能說服人戒菸；家人和朋友密切的支持往往重要得多。)
The steady migration of skilled workers to larger cities has left many rural clinics seriously short of nurses. (技術人才持續遷往大城市，讓許多鄉間診所嚴重缺乏護理師。)

meaning: adj. 超重的；過胖的 vt. 使負擔過重
example: Overweight pets are often fed too many snacks, yet owners rarely realise how much exercise their animals need. (過胖的寵物往往被餵了太多零食，但飼主很少意識到牠們需要多少運動。)
Closer cooperation between bus and rail companies would let passengers buy a single ticket for the whole journey. (公車與鐵路公司更密切的合作，能讓乘客用一張票搭完整段旅程。)
The recent zoological survey recorded fewer frogs than expected, suggesting that the wetland is already drying out rapidly. (最近的動物學調查記錄到的青蛙比預期少，顯示這片濕地正快速乾涸。)

meaning: n. 郵票；印章；跺腳 v. 跺腳；蓋章
example: The letter carried an old stamp that a collector later sold for a surprisingly high price. (這封信上貼著一枚舊郵票，後來被收藏家以高得驚人的價格賣出。)

meaning: n. 口哨；哨子 v. 吹口哨
example: He whistled as he cycled home, glad that the traffic had finally cleared. (他騎車回家時吹著口哨，很高興車流終於疏散了。)

meaning: n. 偵探 adj. 偵探的
example: The detective spent months reviewing old records to solve the theft of the painting. (這名偵探花了幾個月檢視舊紀錄，以偵破畫作失竊案。)
Warehouses occupy land that could have been used for housing near the station. (倉庫佔用了車站附近原本可以蓋住宅的土地。)
The award ceremony was held outdoors because the main hall was being repaired. (頒獎典禮在戶外舉行，因為主禮堂正在整修。)
Doctors can diagnose many conditions earlier thanks to portable scanning equipment in rural clinics. (由於鄉村診所有了可攜式掃描設備，醫師能更早診斷出許多疾病。)
In this score, small dots denote short notes played softly, while thick lines mark sudden increases in volume. (在這份樂譜中，小圓點表示輕聲彈奏的短音，粗線則標示音量突然增強。)

meaning: n. 裂縫；一縷光；叮噹聲 v. 發出叮噹聲
example: A chink in the old stone wall let cold air into the cellar, so the wine slowly spoiled. (老石牆上的一道裂縫讓冷空氣灌進地窖，葡萄酒因此慢慢變質。)
Airport cameras now automatically scan the iris to confirm an international traveller's identity without requiring a printed passport. (機場攝影機現在會自動掃描虹膜，確認國際旅客身分，不必出示紙本護照。)

meaning: n. 資源；財力；應變能力
example: Time is a limited resource in every classroom, so teachers must decide which activities deserve the most attention. (時間是每個教室裡有限的資源，因此教師必須決定哪些活動最值得投入。)
The entire interview was published online without editing, which surprised the politician who had expected a short summary. (整篇訪談未經刪改就刊在網路上，讓原本預期只會刊出簡短摘要的政治人物很意外。)

meaning: vt. 集中體現；為……的典型
example: The crowded night market perhaps epitomises the energy of the city, attracting both locals and curious foreign visitors. (擁擠的夜市或許最能體現這座城市的活力，同時吸引本地人和好奇的外國遊客。)
Warning signs along the river remind visitors that crocodiles live in these waters. (河邊的警告標誌提醒遊客，這片水域有鱷魚棲息。)
Leaders at the climate summit promised to cut emissions but disagreed on how quickly. (各國領袖在氣候高峰會上承諾減排，但對減排的速度意見分歧。)
Staff check the equipment twice a day to ensure that patients are never left waiting. (工作人員每天檢查設備兩次，以確保病患不會一直空等。)
A strange odour in the corridor led the manager to call in a gas technician. (走廊上有一股奇怪的氣味，讓經理請來瓦斯技師檢查。)

meaning: adj. 準確的；正確無誤的
example: Weather models have become accurate enough to warn farmers a week before a heatwave. (天氣模式已準確到能在熱浪來臨前一週提醒農民。)

meaning: adj. 優越的；較高的；上級的 n. 上級；長官
example: Many consumers believe imported goods are superior, though local products often match them. (許多消費者認為進口商品較優越，儘管本地產品往往不輸它們。)

meaning: adj. 溫柔的；嫩的；疼痛的 v. 提出；投標
example: Slow cooking makes even cheap cuts of meat tender enough to pull apart easily. (慢火燉煮能讓便宜的肉塊也變得軟嫩，輕易就能撕開。)
Fewer young people are willing to take jobs that involve working outdoors in winter. (願意從事冬季戶外工作的年輕人越來越少。)
The orchestra will perform in the park on Sunday, provided the weather remains dry and the wind stays calm. (只要天氣保持乾燥、風勢平穩，樂團星期天將在公園演出。)
Rainwater had seeped through the roof and damaged the documents stored in the attic. (雨水從屋頂滲入，損壞了存放在閣樓的文件。)
The ambassador met local exporters to discuss tariffs, then visited a factory that makes parts for wind turbines. (大使會見當地出口商討論關稅，隨後參觀了一家製造風力發電機零件的工廠。)

meaning: n. 失職；犯罪；不良行為
example: The local council hopes that brighter streets will significantly reduce delinquency in the housing estate during late summer. (地方議會希望更明亮的街道能大幅降低這個國宅社區在夏末的青少年不良行為。)

meaning: adj. 故意的；深思熟慮的 v. 深思熟慮；審議
example: Police believe the fire was a deliberate act aimed at forcing the tenants out. (警方認為這場火災是刻意的行為，目的是逼房客搬走。)
The report's implication is that spending on public transport must rise sharply. (這份報告的含意是，大眾運輸的支出必須大幅增加。)
He grabbed a broom and swept the leaves off the pavement before the shop opened. (他在開店前拿起掃帚，把人行道上的落葉掃乾淨。)

meaning: n. 對手；反對者 adj. 對立的
example: Opponents of the plan argue that the new road will cut through a park used by hundreds of children. (這項計畫的反對者主張，新道路將穿過一座數百名孩童使用的公園。)

meaning: n. 贊助者；主辦者 vt. 贊助；主辦
example: A local company agreed to sponsor the science fair, covering prizes, transport and the cost of hiring equipment. (一家本地公司同意贊助科學展，負擔獎品、交通以及租借設備的費用。)
Her decisive handling of the crisis saved the company from losing its biggest client. (她果斷處理這場危機，讓公司免於失去最大的客戶。)

meaning: adj. 大量的；可觀的；堅固的；實質的
example: The study found a substantial drop in child asthma after the bus depot moved outside the city centre. (研究發現，公車總站遷到市中心外之後，兒童氣喘病例大幅減少。)
The housing questionnaire asks residents how often they hear night traffic noise and whether it disturbs their sleep. (這份住宅問卷詢問居民多常聽到夜間交通噪音，以及是否影響睡眠。)
From an employer's viewpoint, flexible hours often matter more than a slightly higher salary. (從雇主的觀點來看，彈性工時往往比略高的薪水更重要。)

meaning: n. 例行公事；慣例 adj. 例行的；常規的
example: Astronauts follow a strict daily routine in orbit, since even small changes can seriously disrupt sleep and concentration. (太空人在軌道上遵循嚴格的日常作息，因為即使小改變也可能嚴重打亂睡眠和專注力。)

meaning: vt. 培養；滋養 n. 養育
example: Good managers nurture talent by giving young staff tasks that stretch their abilities. (好的管理者會給年輕員工一些能激發能力的任務，藉此培養人才。)

meaning: adj. 輕微的；纖細的 vt./n. 輕視
example: A slight rise in temperature can often signal possible infection, so nurses carefully check patients every four hours. (體溫輕微上升往往可能是感染的徵兆，因此護理師每四小時仔細檢查病人。)

meaning: adj. 遺傳的 n. 遺傳學
example: Farmers use genetic testing to choose stronger dairy cattle, though the technology remains too expensive for small farms. (農民利用基因檢測挑選較強壯的乳牛，但這項技術對小農場來說仍太昂貴。)
Solar panels cut bills in summer; similarly, better insulation saves money in winter. (太陽能板能降低夏季的電費；同樣地，做好隔熱也能在冬天省錢。)

meaning: v. 漏；滲出；洩露 n. 漏洞；裂縫
example: The old roof began to leak during the storm, damaging the ceiling and ruining several boxes of books. (老屋頂在暴風雨中開始漏水，損壞了天花板，也毀了好幾箱書。)
Medical students spend hours reading the latest literature on treatments for rare diseases. (醫學生花好幾個小時閱讀罕見疾病治療的最新文獻。)
Local shops suffer badly when roadworks block the narrow pavement, even if the work eventually brings more customers. (路面施工擋住人行道時，當地店家生意大受影響，即使工程最終會帶來更多顧客。)
Lack of sleep can impede recovery, which is why hospitals now dim the lights and reduce night-time noise. (睡眠不足會阻礙康復，因此醫院現在會調暗燈光並減少夜間噪音。)

meaning: n. 春天；彈簧；泉 v. 跳躍；湧現
example: The spring behind the monastery has supplied clean water to pilgrims for centuries, even during long summer droughts. (修道院後方的泉水數世紀來為朝聖者提供乾淨飲水，即使在漫長的夏季乾旱期間也是。)
Biological diversity in the reef has declined since the water became warmer. (自從海水變暖後，這座珊瑚礁的生物多樣性就下降了。)
From the layers of ash, geologists deduced that the volcano had erupted twice. (地質學家從灰燼的層次推斷，這座火山曾經噴發兩次。)
She began a doctorate in marine biology after spending two years recording fish populations on remote coral reefs. (她在偏遠珊瑚礁記錄魚類族群兩年後，開始攻讀海洋生物學博士學位。)
No single absolute rule can cover every case, so managers are encouraged to explain their decisions in writing. (沒有絕對的規則能涵蓋所有情況，因此主管被鼓勵以書面說明他們的決定。)
The theoretical part of the driving test is relatively easy, but many learners fail the practical exam twice. (駕照筆試的理論部分相對簡單，但許多學員路考考了兩次都沒過。)
The internship at a rural clinic taught her how to reassure patients who had never seen a specialist. (在鄉間診所的實習教會她如何安撫從未看過專科醫師的病人。)

meaning: adj. 苗條的；細長的；微薄的
example: The local charity survives on a very slender budget, relying mostly on volunteers, small donations and old equipment. (這家地方慈善機構靠微薄的預算運作，主要仰賴志工、小額捐款和老舊設備。)

meaning: n. 受訪者；回答者；被告
example: Most respondents said they would cycle to work if the city built safe lanes and secure covered parking. (多數受訪者表示，如果市政府興建安全車道和安全的停車空間，他們願意騎車上班。)
Children learn faster when their surroundings are colourful and tidy, according to a recent study of primary classrooms. (根據一項針對小學教室的近期研究，環境色彩豐富又整潔時，孩子學得更快。)

meaning: n. 一對；夫婦；幾個 v. 結合；連接
example: The retired couple opened a small café after leaving the city, and it soon became popular with local workers. (這對退休夫婦離開城市後開了一家小咖啡館，很快就受到當地勞工歡迎。)
The weekly reading programme is voluntary, yet surprisingly nearly half the younger pupils attend sessions before school starts. (每週閱讀課程屬志願參加，但令人意外的是，近半數低年級學生在上課前出席。)

meaning: n. 潛水艇 adj. 海底的
example: Scientists used a small submarine to film creatures living far below the surface. (科學家用小型潛水艇拍攝生活在海面下深處的生物。)

meaning: adj. 商業的 n. 廣告
example: The film was praised by critics but failed as a commercial project, earning far less than its budget. (這部電影受到影評讚賞，但商業表現失敗，收入遠低於製作預算。)
The notion that older workers resist change is not supported by recent surveys. (認為年長員工抗拒改變的這種想法，並未獲得近期調查的支持。)
The station has only one lavatory, which causes long queues on busy mornings. (這座車站只有一間廁所，繁忙的早晨常大排長龍。)
Pilots now carry a tablet instead of heavy bags full of printed charts. (機師現在帶一台平板電腦，而不用提裝滿紙本航圖的沉重袋子。)
The actual journey took six hours, because heavy snow closed the mountain road for most of the morning. (實際車程花了六小時，因為大雪讓山路在上午大部分時間封閉。)

meaning: v. 摺疊；對摺 n. 摺痕
example: Please fold the map along the original lines so it fits in your pocket. (請沿著原本的摺線把地圖摺好，這樣才放得進口袋。)
The instruments on board the research ship measure changes in water temperature hourly. (研究船上的儀器每小時測量一次水溫的變化。)
The government simplified the visa form to reduce the number of rejected applications. (政府簡化了簽證表格，以減少被退回的申請件數。)

meaning: adj. 義務的；強制的；必修的
example: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists travelling along this busy coastal road. (在這條繁忙的海岸公路上騎自行車，戴安全帽是強制規定。)
Delayed flights caused visible irritation among many tired passengers, though staff eventually found everyone a nearby hotel room. (班機延誤讓許多疲憊乘客明顯動怒，不過工作人員最後還是幫大家找到附近的飯店房間。)
The expense of moving abroad often deters many talented students, even when prestigious universities still offer generous scholarships. (移居國外的花費往往讓許多優秀學生卻步，即使名校仍提供豐厚獎學金。)

meaning: n. 混亂；困惑 vt. 弄亂；使困惑
example: The official tax forms were such a muddle that even experienced accountants struggled to find the correct figures. (官方稅表混亂到連經驗豐富的會計師都很難找到正確數字。)
Many common English words originate in Latin, which explains why their spelling often still differs from everyday speech. (許多常用英文單字源自拉丁文，這說明了為何它們的拼法仍與日常說話不同。)
This strong drug can induce drowsiness, so patients are usually advised not to drive immediately after taking it. (這種強效藥物會引起睡意，因此病人通常會被建議服藥後不要立刻開車。)

meaning: v. 交換；兌換；交流 n. 交換；兌換
example: The two universities exchange teaching materials and run a joint summer programme. (這兩所大學交流教材，並合辦暑期課程。)
A pay dispute created disharmony between the two departments for several months. (一場薪資爭議讓兩個部門之間不和諧了好幾個月。)
Managers who cosset their new staff may unintentionally prevent them from developing genuine confidence in difficult everyday situations. (過度呵護新進員工的主管，可能無意間讓他們無法在日常困難情境中建立真正的自信。)

meaning: adj. 獨一無二的；獨特的
example: Each island has a unique style of house, shaped by strong winds and limited supplies of local wood. (每座島都有獨特的房屋風格，這是強風和當地木材供應有限所塑造出來的。)
Teachers sometimes use a simple crossword to review vocabulary, especially on the last day before a short holiday. (教師有時會用簡單的填字遊戲複習單字，尤其是在短假前的最後一天。)
The exhibition explains how atomic research changed medicine as well as the way wars are fought. (這項展覽說明原子研究如何改變了醫學，也改變了戰爭的方式。)
Historians still disagree about the causes of the long war, although most blame a series of failed treaties. (歷史學家對這場長期戰爭的起因仍意見不一，儘管多數人怪罪於一連串失敗的條約。)
A routine check-up revealed high blood pressure, so the doctor asked him to cut down on daily salt. (一次例行健康檢查發現他血壓偏高，因此醫師要他減少每天的鹽分攝取。)

meaning: n. 淤泥 v. 淤塞
example: The dam traps silt that once naturally fertilised the fields downstream, so farmers now rely on chemical fertilisers. (水壩攔住了原本自然肥沃下游田地的淤泥，農民現在只能依賴化學肥料。)

meaning: adj. 包括一切的；包容的
example: The school aims to be inclusive, providing extra support so that children with disabilities can join every activity. (這所學校以包容為目標，提供額外支持，讓身心障礙孩童能參加每一項活動。)
We lost our reservation because the train was delayed, but the restaurant kindly found us another table later. (火車誤點讓我們失去訂位，不過餐廳好意地在稍晚幫我們安排了另一桌。)

meaning: n. 抄本；文字記錄；成績單
example: Students can read a transcript of each lecture, which helps those who struggle to follow the speaker's accent. (學生可以閱讀每堂課的文字記錄，這對聽不懂講者口音的人很有幫助。)
A balanced daily diet should include fresh vegetables, whole grains and enough protein to repair muscles after regular exercise. (均衡的日常飲食應包括新鮮蔬菜、全穀類，以及足夠的蛋白質來修復規律運動後的肌肉。)

meaning: adj. 合理的；通情達理的；適度的
example: It seems reasonable to ask staff to give a week's notice before taking holiday during the busiest season. (要求員工在旺季請假前一週提出通知，似乎很合理。)
The cave served as a temporary abode for shepherds, who moved their flocks to lower ground in winter. (這座山洞曾是牧羊人的臨時住所，他們在冬天把羊群趕往較低的地區。)
A cheap fitness gadget can count your steps, but it cannot replace the habit of walking every day. (便宜的健身小裝置能計算步數，卻無法取代每天走路的習慣。)

meaning: n. 緊急情況 adj. 應急的
example: The council opened a shelter during the emergency, offering hot meals and beds to families whose homes were flooded. (緊急情況期間，市議會開設避難所，為住家淹水的家庭提供熱食和床位。)
The stadium is a lasting legacy of the games, although maintaining it costs the city millions each year. (這座體育場是奧運留下的長遠影響，儘管每年維護得花掉市政府數百萬元。)
Employees with more leisure time often report better mental health, yet many still check work emails at weekends. (空閒時間較多的員工往往表示心理健康較好，但許多人週末仍會查看工作電子郵件。)

meaning: v. 部分重疊；部分相同
example: The two shifts overlap for an hour so that staff can share information properly. (兩個班別有一小時重疊，好讓員工完整交接資訊。)
The senior minister will meet her Japanese counterpart to discuss energy security and the rising price of imported gas. (這位資深部長將會見日本對口部長，討論能源安全和進口天然氣價格上漲的問題。)

meaning: n. 曲調 vt. 調音；調整
example: The piano needs to be tuned before the concert because the humidity has changed. (因為濕度改變，鋼琴必須在音樂會前調音。)

meaning: v. 打擊；罷工 n. 罷工；打擊
example: A three-week strike by rail workers left thousands of commuters without a way to work. (鐵路員工罷工三週，讓數千名通勤族沒有交通工具可以上班。)

meaning: adj. 模稜兩可的；含糊的
example: The contract was ambiguous about who would pay for repairs to the shared roof. (這份合約對於共享屋頂的修繕費用由誰負擔，寫得含糊不清。)
The famous painting represents a busy harbour, though the artist never actually visited the coast during his lifetime. (這幅名畫描繪一個繁忙的港口，不過畫家生前其實從未到過海邊。)
Daily newspaper sales have gradually vanished in many towns, leaving older readers without a familiar source of local news. (許多城鎮的日報銷量逐漸消失，讓年長讀者少了熟悉的在地新聞來源。)
The report recommends a clear mechanism for handling complaints about noise from factories. (這份報告建議建立一套明確的機制，處理工廠噪音的申訴。)

meaning: n. 爭論；爭端 v. 爭論；質疑
example: The dispute over pay lasted six months before both sides finally agreed to accept an independent arbitrator's decision. (薪資爭端持續六個月，雙方最後才同意接受獨立仲裁人的裁決。)
Most of the furniture in the flat was bought second-hand and repainted. (這間公寓裡的家具大多是買二手再重新上漆的。)

meaning: n. 標準 adj. 標準的
example: The school's standard of teaching has improved since experienced staff began closely mentoring newly qualified colleagues every week. (自從資深教師每週密切指導新進教師後，這所學校的教學水準便提升了。)
A typical weekend in the village involves a market, a football match and a long walk by the river. (這個村莊典型的週末包括逛市場、看足球賽，以及沿河長時間散步。)
New sea walls were built to strengthen the town's defences against rising tides. (鎮上興建了新的海堤，以加強抵禦潮水上漲的能力。)
My uncle is a workaholic who answers emails at midnight, yet he insists that he never feels tired. (我叔叔是個工作狂，半夜還在回電子郵件，卻堅稱自己從不覺得累。)

meaning: adj. 未察覺的；不知道的
example: Many users are unaware that free apps quietly collect their location data and often sell it to advertising companies. (許多使用者未察覺免費應用程式會悄悄蒐集他們的位置資料，還常賣給廣告公司。)
Coastal erosion has already destroyed several metres of the path along the cliffs. (海岸侵蝕已經摧毀了懸崖步道好幾公尺的路段。)
This lane is used exclusively by pedestrians, so delivery vans must park outside. (這條巷道專供行人使用，因此送貨廂型車必須停在外面。)
These birds lose their brightest feathers in autumn and grow duller ones for winter. (這些鳥在秋天換掉最鮮豔的羽毛，長出較暗淡的羽毛過冬。)
Brand names that are easily pronounceable often sell better in foreign markets than difficult ones. (容易發音的品牌名稱，在國外市場往往比拗口的名字賣得好。)
The bare walls made the room feel cold, so we hung several colourful prints above the large sofa. (光禿的牆面讓房間顯得冷清，因此我們在大沙發上方掛了幾幅色彩鮮豔的畫。)
Our luggage arrived two days late, so we had to buy formal clothes quickly before the wedding began. (我們的行李晚了兩天才到，因此婚禮開始前必須趕緊添購正式服裝。)

meaning: n. 軟管 vt. 用軟管澆水
example: Neighbours used an old garden hose to keep the flames away from the wooden house until firefighters arrived. (鄰居用一條老舊的園藝軟管阻止火勢蔓延到木屋，直到消防員抵達。)
A single broken bulb left the whole stairwell dark, so residents now carry torches when they come home. (一個壞掉的燈泡就讓整個樓梯間一片漆黑，因此住戶現在回家都會帶手電筒。)
An internal review found that the delays were caused by poor planning. (一份內部檢討發現，這些延誤是規劃不當造成的。)
The new battery stores energy by moving ions between two layers, which makes it lighter than older designs. (這種新電池透過在兩層之間移動離子來儲存能量，因此比舊款設計更輕。)

meaning: v. 巡航；乘船遊覽 n. 郵輪旅遊
example: The cruise stops at four islands, giving passengers a full day on each one. (這趟郵輪旅程停靠四座島嶼，每座島都讓乘客停留一整天。)
Mirrors in the exhibition create the illusion that the room has no walls. (展覽中的鏡子營造出這個房間沒有牆壁的錯覺。)

meaning: v. 剃；刮（鬍子） n. 刮鬍
example: He shaved off his beard before the interview at the bank where he hoped to work. (他在那家銀行的面試前把鬍子颳掉，他希望能在這家銀行工作。)

meaning: adj. 難以置信的；驚人的
example: It seems incredible that the bridge was built in only eighteen months. (這座橋只花十八個月就蓋好，實在令人難以置信。)

meaning: n. 脊椎動物 adj. 有脊椎的
example: The museum's collection includes every native vertebrate found on the island, from tiny bats to large sea turtles. (這座博物館的收藏包括島上所有原生脊椎動物，從小型蝙蝠到大型海龜都有。)
The family built a thriving business through industrious work over three generations. (這個家族靠三代人勤奮工作，建立起興旺的事業。)
A diet high in fibre keeps the intestine healthy and reduces digestive problems. (高纖維的飲食能保持腸道健康，並減少消化問題。)
The clinic is a lonely outpost, staffed by one nurse and a visiting doctor. (這間診所是孤零零的偏遠據點，只有一名護理師和一位巡診醫師。)

meaning: adj. 一般的；普遍的 n. 將軍
example: The general view among researchers is that regular moderate exercise still benefits almost everyone, including people over eighty. (研究人員的普遍看法是，規律的中度運動仍對幾乎所有人有益，包括八十歲以上的人。)

meaning: v. 打擾；煩惱 n. 麻煩
example: Please do not bother the driver while the bus is moving, since even a short distraction can be dangerous. (公車行駛時請不要打擾司機，因為即使短暫分心都可能造成危險。)
A consignment of winter coats arrived after the unexpected cold spell, so the shop reduced them by half. (一批冬季外套在意外寒流過後才送到，因此店家把它們降價一半出清。)
The university administrator explained that the delay was caused by a new computer system, not by careless staff. (大學行政人員說明，延誤是新電腦系統造成的，並非員工疏忽。)
By formal convention, the most senior guest speaks first, although younger employees now often quietly question this custom. (依照正式慣例，最資深的賓客先發言，不過年輕員工現在常私下質疑這項習俗。)
The city now collects organic food waste separately and turns it into compost for parks and community gardens. (市政府現在分開回收有機廚餘，並將其製成公園和社區花園用的堆肥。)
The child stared nervously at the trapeze for minutes before climbing the ladder and attempting her first swing. (這孩子緊張地盯著高空鞦韆好幾分鐘，才爬上梯子嘗試第一次擺盪。)
A new pedestrian crossing was added at the busiest intersection in the district. (這個地區最繁忙的十字路口新設了一處行人穿越道。)
The concept of gravity is easy to name but surprisingly hard to explain to a class of curious children. (重力的概念不難說出口，但要向一群好奇的孩子解釋卻出奇地難。)
A diet high in salt increases cardiovascular risk, even in people who exercise regularly and otherwise feel healthy. (高鹽飲食會增加心血管風險，即使是規律運動、其他方面自覺健康的人也不例外。)

meaning: adj. 謙遜的；卑微的 vt. 使謙卑
example: The scientist remained humble despite her international award, patiently crediting the young students who had collected most of the data. (這位科學家雖獲國際獎項仍保持謙遜，耐心把功勞歸給蒐集大部分數據的年輕學生。)
The lecture on sleep explained why teenagers struggle to wake early, and several parents stayed to ask questions. (這場關於睡眠的演講說明了青少年為何難以早起，會後有幾位家長留下來提問。)

meaning: n. 櫃檯 v. 反駁；抵制 adv. 相反地
example: The pharmacist at the counter warned me that the tablets should be taken with food, not strong coffee. (櫃檯的藥師提醒我，這些藥錠應搭配食物服用，不要配濃咖啡。)
The school's brass group practised in the hall every lunchtime, which annoyed teachers trying to quietly mark essays. (學校銅管樂團每天午餐時間都在禮堂練習，讓想安靜批改作文的老師很困擾。)
The reserve's native fauna has recovered since hunting stopped, although several species remain rare and need constant protection. (禁獵之後，保護區的原生動物群已經恢復，不過仍有幾種動物數量稀少，需要持續保護。)
The club expelled two members for repeatedly breaking the rules of the ground. (這個俱樂部開除兩名成員，因為他們屢次違反場地規定。)
Countries near the equator receive roughly twelve hours of daylight all year round. (赤道附近的國家全年大約都有十二小時的日照。)
Governments that invest in public early education often save considerable money later on healthcare and crime, according to economists. (經濟學家指出，投資公共幼兒教育的政府，日後往往能在醫療和犯罪防治上省下可觀經費。)
His essay on food waste won a prize in a national writing competition. (他那篇關於食物浪費的文章，在全國寫作比賽中獲獎。)
She dedicated thirty years of her life to improving conditions in the mines. (她奉獻了三十年的人生，改善礦場的工作環境。)
Many newspapers still print astrology columns, even though scientists doubt their accuracy. (許多報紙仍刊登占星術專欄，儘管科學家懷疑它們的準確性。)
Few countries have attained the emission targets they agreed to ten years ago. (很少國家達成了十年前議定的排放目標。)
The divisional final unexpectedly attracted a record local crowd, even though both teams had lost several key players. (這場分區決賽意外吸引創紀錄的本地觀眾，儘管兩隊都少了幾名主力球員。)
Her ambition is to run a marathon on every continent, though serious injuries have twice delayed her plans. (她的抱負是在每個洲跑一場馬拉松，不過嚴重的運動傷害已兩度讓計畫延後。)

meaning: n. 範圍；系列；山脈 v. 變動；排列
example: The private clinic offers a wide range of treatments, from simple physiotherapy to surgery for serious joint problems. (這家私人診所提供各式各樣的療程，從簡單的物理治療到嚴重關節問題的手術都有。)
The ultimate goal of the training is to complete the mountain climb without stopping, even in poor weather. (這項訓練的最終目標，是即使天候不佳也能不休息地完成登山。)
The school counsellor noticed that a quiet pupil had stopped eating lunch and arranged a meeting with his parents. (學校輔導老師注意到一名安靜的學生不再吃午餐，於是安排與他的父母會談。)

meaning: v. 拍打；拍動 n. 蓋片；慌亂
example: Seagulls flapped their wings above the harbour as the fishing boats came in. (漁船進港時，海鷗在港口上空拍動翅膀。)
Better portion planning has cut wastage in the restaurant kitchen, saving money and reducing the amount sent to landfill. (更妥善的分量規劃減少了餐廳廚房的損耗，既省錢又減少送往掩埋場的垃圾量。)
The earthquake destroyed older houses that had never been strengthened against shaking. (這場地震摧毀了從未做過耐震補強的舊房屋。)
A small device worn on the wrist can warn diabetes patients before their blood sugar falls dangerously low. (戴在手腕上的小型裝置能在糖尿病患者的血糖降到危險低點前提出警告。)
Many cities now regulate the number of cars allowed into the historic centre. (許多城市現在管制進入歷史城區的車輛數量。)

meaning: n. 黴菌；模具 v. 塑造
example: The bread was covered in green mould after only three days, because the small kitchen was slightly too warm. (麵包才放三天就長滿綠色黴菌，因為小廚房稍微太熱了。)

meaning: adj. 潛在的 n. 潛力
example: Teachers often underestimate the genuine potential of quieter students, who may produce more thoughtful work when given time. (教師常低估安靜學生的真正潛力，這些學生只要有時間，往往能交出更有深度的作品。)
Managers were given discretion to decide which staff could work flexible hours. (經理被賦予判斷權，自行決定哪些員工可以彈性上班。)

meaning: adj. 有抱負的；有野心的
example: The firm has set an ambitious target to cut international business flights by half within the next three years. (這家公司訂下雄心勃勃的目標，要在未來三年內把國際商務飛行減半。)

meaning: adj. 短暫的；簡短的 n. 摘要 vt. 向……簡報
example: After a brief pause, the speaker returned to the question everyone was waiting for. (短暫停頓之後，講者回到大家一直在等的那個問題。)
The dorm was converted into offices after the college built a new hall of residence. (學院蓋了新的宿舍之後，這棟宿舍被改成了辦公室。)

meaning: v. 代替 n. 替代品；替補
example: Coconut oil is often used as a substitute for butter in local cooking. (在本地烹調中，椰子油常被當作奶油的替代品。)

meaning: adj. 顯著的；引人注目的
example: The most striking feature of the village is its wall of coloured tiles. (這個村落最引人注目的特色，就是那面彩磚牆。)

meaning: n. 海盜；盜版者 vt. 盜版；盜用
example: Studios lose millions each year when films are pirated before their official release. (電影在正式上映前被盜版，讓片商每年損失數百萬。)
Keeping the old refrigerator half full helps it run efficiently, though many households still waste food every week. (讓舊冰箱保持半滿有助於它有效率運轉，不過許多家庭每週仍丟棄食物。)

meaning: vt. 使減到最低；最小化
example: Wearing ear protection is the simplest way to minimise damage from loud machinery. (戴上耳部防護是最簡單的方法，能把吵雜機械造成的傷害減到最低。)

meaning: adj. 富有想像力的；創新的
example: The library's imaginative use of old containers has created a popular reading garden. (圖書館有創意地運用舊貨櫃，打造出一座受歡迎的閱讀花園。)

meaning: n. 利潤；收益 v. 獲益；有利於
example: The bus company made a profit last year, but it still plans to raise fares and cut rural routes. (這家公車公司去年有獲利，卻仍計畫調漲票價並裁減鄉村路線。)
The decrepit flat had no working heating, yet the landlord refused to repair anything properly before the winter. (這間破舊公寓沒有可用的暖氣，房東卻拒絕在冬天前好好修繕任何東西。)
Many voters admit they are ignorant about how local taxes are actually spent. (許多選民承認，他們對地方稅金實際上怎麼花並不清楚。)
The young leopard escaped from its enclosure, but keepers found it sleeping safely under a tree within hours. (年幼的豹逃出圍欄，但照護員幾小時內就發現牠安全地睡在樹下。)
Her mastery of the violin impressed the judges, although she had only started formal lessons five years earlier. (她對小提琴的精通讓評審印象深刻，儘管她五年前才開始正式上課。)
The forecast promised a dry week, so farmers rushed to harvest the wheat before the rain finally returned. (氣象預報說會有一週乾燥天氣，農民趕在雨終於回來前收割小麥。)
Modern surgery requires great precision, which is why increasingly complex operations now rely on robots and skilled doctors. (現代手術需要高度精確，因此越來越複雜的手術現在都仰賴機器人和技術純熟的醫師。)

meaning: v. 引用；報價 n. 引文；報價
example: The article quoted a senior scientist who carefully warned that the river would still remain polluted for decades. (這篇文章引用一位資深科學家的話，他謹慎警告這條河仍會持續受污染數十年。)
A recent comparative study found that older patients often recovered faster at home than in large traditional hospitals. (一項近期的比較研究發現，年長病人在家往往比在傳統醫院恢復得更快。)

meaning: v. 招募；招收 n. 新成員；新兵
example: Rural clinics still struggle to recruit experienced doctors, even when they offer free housing and shorter working hours. (鄉間診所仍難以招募到有經驗的醫師，即使提供免費住宿和較短工時也一樣。)

meaning: n. 光澤；註解 v. 註釋；掩飾
example: The gloss on the car slowly faded after years of parking beside the sea, where salt damages paint. (這輛車長年停在海邊，鹽分侵蝕烤漆，光澤因此慢慢褪去。)
The club committee voted to rebuild the old changing rooms, but postponed a decision on raising membership fees. (俱樂部委員會表決重建老舊的更衣室，但延後決定是否調漲會員費。)

meaning: n. 流放；流亡者 vt. 放逐
example: The journalist spent five years in voluntary exile, reporting carefully from abroad while friends at home faced arrest. (這名記者自願流亡五年，在海外謹慎報導，而國內的朋友則面臨逮捕。)

meaning: n. 代表 adj. 有代表性的
example: A senior union representative met the managers to discuss safety, but no final agreement was reached that afternoon. (工會資深代表與主管會面討論安全問題，但那天下午並未達成最終協議。)

meaning: v. 顛倒；撤銷 n. 相反；背面 adj. 相反的
example: The government reversed its decision to close the local village school after angry parents collected thousands of signatures. (憤怒的家長募集數千個簽名後，政府撤銷了關閉當地村校的決定。)

meaning: n. 財政；金融 vt. 提供資金
example: She studied finance at university because she wanted to help small family businesses plan their budgets more carefully. (她大學攻讀金融，因為她想幫助小型家族企業更謹慎地規劃預算。)
The minister was forced to resign after the inquiry published its findings. (調查報告公布結果後，這位部長被迫辭職。)
Careful preparation before the monsoon season saves lives in villages built on low ground. (在雨季來臨前做好準備，能讓地勢低窪的村莊保住更多性命。)
Poor eyesight among older drivers is checked every two years in many countries. (在許多國家，年長駕駛人的視力每兩年檢查一次。)
Some plants thrive in poor soil, which is why they are used to restore land damaged by mining. (有些植物在貧瘠土壤中仍能茂盛生長，因此被用來復育受採礦破壞的土地。)
Good judgment in traffic often matters more than how fast a car can go. (在交通中，良好的判斷力往往比車子能跑多快更重要。)

meaning: adj. 向外的；外表的 adv. 向外
example: His outward calm hid the pressure he felt while running the family business. (他外表鎮定，掩飾了經營家族事業時承受的壓力。)
The local library closed for repairs without warning; consequently, students had to study in crowded cafés all week. (當地圖書館無預警關閉維修，因此學生整週只能擠在擁擠的咖啡館念書。)
They entertain friends on the balcony every summer, although the flat is far too small for big gatherings. (他們每年夏天都在陽台招待朋友，儘管這間公寓小得容不下大型聚會。)
These new buildings are designed to withstand winds of over two hundred kilometres per hour. (這些新建築的設計，能抵擋每小時兩百公里以上的強風。)
The anthropologist studied ancient tools kept in a local museum and concluded that they were used for fishing. (這位人類學家研究當地博物館收藏的古代工具，推斷它們是用來捕魚的。)

meaning: n. 梳子；蜂巢 v. 梳理；徹底搜查
example: Volunteers carefully combed the whole beach for broken plastic after the storm, filling more than thirty large bags. (暴風雨後，志工仔細徹底搜查整片海灘撿拾破碎塑膠，裝滿了三十多個大袋子。)
The guesthouse is suitably quiet for light sleepers, yet only a short walk from the busy night market. (這間民宿對淺眠的人來說夠安靜，離熱鬧的夜市又只有短短一段路。)
Workers used a simple pulley to lift heavy tiles onto the roof of the tower. (工人用簡單的滑輪把沉重的屋瓦吊上塔樓屋頂。)

meaning: n. 特權；優惠 vt. 給予特權
example: Many employees see working from home as a privilege rather than a right. (許多員工把居家辦公視為一種特權，而不是權利。)
The small island's infrastructure cannot support a large hospital, so serious cases are quickly flown to the mainland. (這座小島的基礎設施無法支撐大型醫院，因此重症病患會迅速被空運到本島。)
The council allocated half its budget to repairing roads and water pipes. (市議會把一半的預算分配給道路和水管的維修。)
A teaching qualification is not enough on its own; new staff also need months of supervised classroom practice. (光有教師資格還不夠，新進教師還需要數個月的課堂實習督導。)
The clinic plans to expand its evening service, since most patients cannot take time off work during the day. (這家診所計畫擴張夜間服務，因為多數病人白天無法請假。)

meaning: n. 陷阱；圈套 vt. 誘捕；使陷入困境
example: Heavy snow trapped several cars on the narrow mountain pass, so local rescue teams worked through the night. (大雪讓好幾輛車受困在狹窄的山路隘口，當地救援隊連夜搶救。)

meaning: vt. 拘禁 n. 實習生
example: The unpaid intern wrote three articles a week, but only one was actually published in the local newspaper. (這名實習生每週寫三篇文章，但只有一篇真的刊登在地方報紙上。)
Volunteers repainted the old school hall in bright colours during the holidays, using paints chosen by the pupils themselves. (志工在假期間用學生自己挑選的油漆，把老舊的學校禮堂重新漆成鮮豔的顏色。)
The specialist explained the treatment in simple language, which reassured the patient far more than the leaflets did. (專家以簡單的語言說明療程，讓病人安心的程度遠超過那些衛教單張。)
Migratory fish return to this river each spring, although dams have made the long upstream journey increasingly difficult. (遷徙性魚類每年春天都會回到這條河，儘管水壩讓漫長的逆流旅程越來越困難。)
Good nutrition matters for older people too, especially when serious illness makes daily cooking properly difficult or unappealing. (良好的營養對年長者也很重要，尤其是重病讓好好煮飯變得困難或提不起勁時。)
Fishing boats shelter in a small inlet whenever the weather turns rough. (天氣轉壞時，漁船就停泊在一處小水灣避風。)

meaning: vt. 審查 n. 審查員
example: The school refused to censor the student newspaper, even after parents complained about an article on canteen food. (即使家長抱怨一篇關於餐廳食物的報導，學校仍拒絕審查學生報紙。)

meaning: adj. 普遍的；分佈廣泛的
example: There is widespread agreement that the old bus station must be rebuilt. (大家普遍同意，這座老舊的巴士站必須重建。)

meaning: n. 危險；隱患 v. 冒險；使遭受危險
example: Loose cables lying across the path are a serious hazard for walkers. (散落在步道上的電纜，對行人構成嚴重的危險。)

meaning: adj. 後方的 n. 後部 v. 飼養；撫養
example: The rear light on my bicycle stopped working, so I replaced the small battery before cycling home in the dark. (我腳踏車的後燈壞了，因此我在天黑前騎車回家前先換了小電池。)
Shareholders voted against the plan because it would reduce profits for several years. (股東投票否決這項計畫，因為它會讓利潤減少好幾年。)
Three firms submitted a bid for the contract to build the new sewage plant. (有三家公司投標爭取興建新污水處理廠的合約。)

meaning: adj. 點著的 vi. 降落；下車
example: Passengers for the main airport should alight at the third stop and then follow the clearly marked walkway. (要前往主要機場的乘客，請在第三站下車，然後沿著標示清楚的走道前進。)

meaning: n. 信用；學分；功勞 vt. 歸功於；記入貸方
example: Much of the credit for the discovery belongs to a young researcher who noticed a faint pattern in the data. (這項發現的功勞大半歸於一位年輕研究員，他注意到數據中一個微弱的規律。)
A shrewd buyer will compare three quotes before agreeing to any repair work. (精明的買方會在同意任何維修工程前，先比較三家報價。)

meaning: n. 沙漠 adj. 荒涼的 v. 拋棄；遺棄
example: Crossing the desert by bus takes two days, so travellers are advised to carry far more water than usual. (搭巴士橫越沙漠要兩天，因此旅客被建議攜帶比平常多得多的水。)
Doctors concluded that the illness was caused by contaminated water, not by the food served at the hotel. (醫師推斷這起疾病是受污染的水造成的，而非飯店提供的食物。)

meaning: n. 炸藥 adj. 爆炸的；易怒的
example: Explosive materials must be strictly stored far from nearby homes, which makes mining in crowded valleys increasingly difficult. (爆炸性材料必須嚴格存放在遠離附近民宅的地方，這讓擁擠山谷中的採礦越來越困難。)
There are inherent risks in any job that involves working at great heights. (任何涉及在高處工作的職業，都存在固有的風險。)

meaning: adj. 遍及全球的 adv. 遍及全球地
example: The company has a world-wide network of suppliers, which reduces its dependence on one region. (這家公司在全球都有供應商網路，這降低了它對單一地區的依賴。)
He had to grope along the corridor because the power had gone out. (因為停電，他只能沿著走廊摸索前進。)

meaning: n. 槓桿；操縱桿 vt. 撬動
example: Pulling the red lever shuts off the gas supply to the whole building. (拉下紅色槓桿，就會關閉整棟大樓的瓦斯供應。)
The trial raised serious ethical questions because patients were not fully told that the treatment was still experimental. (這項試驗引發嚴重的倫理問題，因為病人未被告知完整實情：療程仍屬實驗性質。)
Parents welcomed the steady improvement in reading scores, though teachers warned that one good year proves surprisingly little. (家長樂見閱讀成績穩定改善，不過教師警告，單一年度的好表現所能證明的其實少得令人意外。)
The large vacant office was turned into a busy community kitchen, which now serves hot meals every weekday. (這間空置的大辦公室被改造成社區廚房，現在每個平日都供應熱食。)

meaning: n. 逃學者；曠課者 vi. 曠課
example: The truant was found quietly helping at his uncle's stall, and teachers soon discovered why he avoided school. (這名曠課的學生被發現默默在叔叔的攤位幫忙，老師很快就發現他逃避上學的原因。)
The international doping scandal damaged the sport's reputation for years, even after several young athletes were finally banned. (這起國際禁藥醜聞多年來重創這項運動的聲譽，即使幾名年輕選手最後遭到禁賽。)
Doctors are carefully testing for latent infections before patients themselves begin strong treatment that weakens the immune system. (醫師在病人自身開始接受會削弱免疫系統的強效治療前，先仔細檢驗潛在感染。)
The tenant repaired the leaking roof himself and then asked the owner to urgently reduce next month's rent. (房客自己修了漏水的屋頂，然後要求房東緊急調降下個月的租金。)

meaning: adj. 精神病的；精神科的
example: The local psychiatric team visits patients at home, which helps those who find large hospitals particularly frightening or confusing. (當地精神科團隊到病人家中訪視，這對覺得大型醫院特別可怕或令人困惑的人很有幫助。)
Rangers warn visitors not to light a campfire when the forest is this dry. (森林這麼乾燥時，巡守員警告遊客不要生營火。)

meaning: vt. 支持；增強 n. 墊子
example: Lower interest rates may bolster new local small businesses, but only if banks are genuinely willing to lend. (較低的利率或許能增強當地小型企業，但前提是銀行真的願意放款。)
Many immigrants open small shops that bring life back to empty neighbourhoods. (許多移民開設小店，讓原本冷清的社區重新有了生氣。)
The teacher asked pupils to arrange the pictures in the correct sequence, then explain the story in their own words. (老師要求學生把圖片按正確順序排列，再用自己的話說明故事。)
A warming ocean can slowly upset the entire ecosystem, affecting everything from tiny plankton to large commercial fish. (海洋暖化會慢慢打亂整個生態系統，從微小浮游生物到大型商業魚類都受影響。)

meaning: n. 關心；擔憂 vt. 涉及；使擔憂
example: A growing concern among local parents is the increasing amount of time children spend staring at small screens. (當地家長越來越擔憂的一件事，是孩子盯著小螢幕的時間不斷增加。)

meaning: v. 轉移；調動；轉乘 n. 轉移；轉乘
example: Employees can transfer to another department after a full year, provided they successfully complete the required internal training. (員工滿一年後可以轉調其他部門，前提是順利完成規定的內部訓練。)

meaning: adj. 外來的；異國情調的
example: The market sells exotic fruit that most shoppers have never seen before. (這個市場賣一些大多數消費者從未見過的異國水果。)
Most of the cooking water evaporated during the slow simmer, so the thick sauce became far too salty. (慢火燉煮時大部分水分都蒸發了，因此濃稠的醬汁變得實在太鹹。)
She believes her destiny was shaped by the village where she grew up. (她相信自己的命運，是由成長的村莊所塑造的。)

meaning: v. 躲藏；隱藏 n. 獸皮
example: The old wallpaper hides cracks that would cost a lot to repair properly. (舊壁紙遮住了裂縫，而要好好修補這些裂縫所費不貲。)

meaning: adj. 以前的；前者的 n. 前者
example: The former international champion now quietly coaches young local teenagers, although she rarely talks about her own successes. (這位前國際冠軍現在默默指導當地青少年，儘管她很少談起自己的成就。)

meaning: adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的
example: The coastal weather was awful throughout the trip, yet the children still enjoyed exploring the small narrow caves. (整趟旅程沿海天氣都很糟，不過孩子們仍很享受探索狹小的洞穴。)

meaning: adj. 疼痛的；惱火的 n. 瘡；痛處
example: After a full day of digging, his shoulders were sore for two days. (挖了一整天之後，他的肩膀痠痛了兩天。)
Virtually all the flats in the new block have already been sold. (這棟新大樓的公寓幾乎全部都賣完了。)

meaning: adv. 有形地；可具體感受地
example: Local air quality has improved tangibly since the factory installed new filters, and asthma cases have fallen steadily. (自從工廠裝了新濾網後，當地空氣品質有明顯可感受的改善，氣喘病例也穩定下降。)
A stone from a lorry cracked his windscreen on the motorway yesterday. (昨天在高速公路上，一顆從卡車掉下的石頭砸裂了他的擋風玻璃。)

meaning: adj. 體面的；像樣的；正派的
example: After years of low pay, she finally found a decent job with regular hours. (在多年低薪之後，她終於找到一份工時正常、像樣的工作。)

meaning: adj. 沖積的 n. 沖積土
example: The rich alluvial plain has attracted farmers for centuries, and its buried layers now reveal ancient nearby settlements. (這片肥沃的沖積平原數世紀來吸引農民定居，埋藏的土層如今揭露了附近的古代聚落。)
The museum's photographs show the great slum that once stood where the modern grand opera house now stands. (博物館的照片顯示，這片大貧民窟曾座落在如今現代宏偉歌劇院的位置。)
Small factories distill local fruit into a strong drink sold across the region. (小型工廠把當地水果蒸餾成烈酒，銷往整個地區。)
A smaller car is far more economical for drivers who rarely carry passengers. (對很少載人的駕駛來說，較小的車子省油得多。)
The fate of the old town hall remains uncertain, as nobody has agreed how to fund its repair. (老市政廳的命運仍未定，因為大家還沒就如何籌措維修經費達成共識。)
Travellers should carry enough regular medication for the whole trip, since local pharmacies may be closed at weekends. (旅客應攜帶整趟旅程足夠的例行藥物，因為當地藥局週末可能不營業。)

meaning: n. 目標；靶子 vt. 以……為目標
example: The school met its annual reading target, but still fell surprisingly short in mathematics despite weekly extra lessons. (這所學校達成了年度閱讀目標，但儘管每週加課，數學表現仍出乎意料地未達標。)

meaning: adj. 獨立的；自主的 n. 無黨派人士
example: The study was funded by a charity, which allowed the researchers to remain completely independent of industry pressure. (這項研究由慈善機構資助，讓研究人員得以完全獨立於產業壓力。)
The fire spread quickly within a radius of two kilometres, forcing hundreds of residents to leave their homes. (火勢在半徑兩公里內迅速蔓延，迫使數百名居民撤離家園。)
The fossil was found by a walker who reported it to the local museum. (這塊化石是一位散步的民眾發現的，他向當地博物館通報。)

meaning: n. 陰涼處；色度；細微差別 vt. 遮蔽
example: Planting trees along this street provides shade and lowers summer temperatures considerably. (沿著這條街種樹能提供陰涼，並明顯降低夏季的溫度。)
The headmaster cancelled afternoon classes so that the whole school could watch the national team play in the final. (校長取消下午的課，讓全校都能觀看國家隊踢決賽。)
Doctors are carefully trying to wean patients off strong painkillers by offering regular physiotherapy and gentle exercise instead. (醫師正謹慎地幫病人戒除強效止痛藥，改為提供規律的物理治療和溫和運動。)
The committee comprises eight members drawn from local businesses and residents' groups. (這個委員會由八名成員組成，來自當地企業與居民團體。)

meaning: adj. 穩定的；沉穩的 n. 馬廄
example: Her general condition is now stable, although she will still need regular check-ups for at least a year. (她的整體狀況現在穩定了，不過至少一年內仍需定期回診檢查。)
The team's overall home performance was disappointing, yet the coach insisted that younger players had gained valuable experience. (球隊整體主場表現令人失望，但教練堅稱年輕球員已獲得寶貴經驗。)
Farmers in the delta grow rice on land that the river refreshes each year. (三角洲的農民在每年河水重新滋養的土地上種稻。)
Urban planners are trying to keep small workshops in the city centre. (都市規劃人員正努力讓小型工作坊留在市中心。)

meaning: n. 讚美；問候 vt. 讚美
example: A compliment from a former pupil meant more to her than any official award she had ever received. (一名昔日學生的一句讚美，對她來說比任何曾獲得的官方獎項更有意義。)
Poor execution turned a sensible plan into a series of expensive mistakes. (執行不力，讓一項明智的計畫變成連串昂貴的錯誤。)
The old harbour is protected as heritage, so no new buildings may block the view. (這座舊港口被列為遺產保護，因此新大樓不得擋住景觀。)

meaning: adj. 適當的 vt. 挪用；撥款
example: It is not appropriate to prescribe antibiotics for every cough, since most infections simply clear up without them. (每個咳嗽都開抗生素並不適當，因為大多數感染不用藥就會自行痊癒。)

meaning: adj. 每年的 n. 年刊；一年生植物
example: The annual check-up includes routine blood tests, a hearing check and a short conversation about diet and exercise. (年度健康檢查包括例行抽血、聽力檢查，以及簡短討論飲食與運動。)
The photographs depict life in the valley before the dam was built. (這些照片描繪了水壩興建之前，山谷裡的生活樣貌。)
Digital literacy is now as important as basic reading, yet many older workers have never received formal training. (數位素養現在和基本讀寫能力一樣重要，但許多較年長的勞工從未受過正式訓練。)
Engineers calculated that the bridge could safely carry twice its current volume of traffic. (工程師計算出這座橋能安全承載目前兩倍的交通量。)

meaning: n. 奢華；奢侈品 adj. 奢華的
example: A quiet hotel room is a rare luxury in this busy resort, especially during the long summer holidays. (在這座熱鬧的度假勝地，安靜的飯店房間是難得的奢侈品，尤其是在漫長的暑假期間。)
Tourists buy small souvenirs at the market, which keeps many families employed. (遊客在市場買些小紀念品，這讓許多家庭得以維持生計。)

meaning: vt. 購買 n. 購買；購買的物品
example: They purchased a small family flat near the busy station, hoping to avoid a long daily commute entirely. (他們在車站附近買了一間小公寓，希望能完全避免每天長途通勤。)

meaning: adj. 不斷的；持續的；忠實的 n. 常數
example: Constant short interruptions make it hard for nurses to concentrate, so the ward now has a quiet hour. (不斷的短暫打擾讓護理師難以專心，因此病房現在設有一小時安靜時段。)
Some frogs survive the long dry season in dormancy, emerging only when the first heavy rains finally arrive. (有些青蛙以休眠狀態度過漫長的乾季，直到第一場大雨終於來臨才現身。)

meaning: adj. 特定的；特殊的；詳細的 n. 細節
example: That particular treatment works well for adults, but it has not yet been properly tested on young children. (那種特定療程對成人效果很好，但尚未在幼童身上做過妥善測試。)
The newspaper raised its online subscription by ten per cent, and thousands of readers cancelled within a month. (這家報紙把線上訂閱費調漲一成，一個月內就有數千名讀者取消訂閱。)

meaning: n. 音高；場地；瀝青 v. 投擲；顛簸
example: The school's new pitch drains much better, so local matches are no longer cancelled after light winter rain. (學校的新球場排水好多了，因此冬季小雨過後地方比賽不再取消。)
This ticket entitles the holder to two free visits to the exhibition. (這張票券讓持有者可免費參觀展覽兩次。)
The shopkeeper opened the metal shutters at seven, revealing shelves freshly filled with warm bread and local fruit. (店家七點拉起金屬百葉窗，露出剛補滿溫熱麵包和當地水果的貨架。)
Developers want to demolish the old cinema, but residents argue that it could successfully become a community centre. (建商想拆除老電影院，但居民主張它其實可以成功轉型為社區中心。)
Durable boots matter more than fashionable ones for people who work outdoors. (對戶外工作者來說，耐用的靴子比時髦的更重要。)
Rural primary schools often cope with increasingly tight budgets by successfully sharing specialist staff with nearby local institutions. (小型學校往往透過與附近機構共享專業人員，來應付日益緊縮的預算。)
The paper's circulation has fallen since readers moved to free news sites. (自從讀者轉向免費新聞網站後，這份報紙的發行量就下滑了。)
The tradition of swimming in the sea on New Year's Day attracts hundreds of people, despite the freezing water. (元旦在海裡游泳的傳統吸引了數百人參加，儘管海水冰冷刺骨。)

meaning: n. 益處；津貼 v. 有益於；受益
example: One clear benefit of regular working from home is that employees save both commuting time and considerable money. (規律居家辦公的一項明顯益處，是員工同時省下通勤時間和可觀的金錢。)

meaning: v. 腐爛；衰敗 n. 腐爛；衰敗
example: Sugary drinks encourage teeth to decay, which is why many dentists want clearer warnings on the front of packaging. (含糖飲料會促使牙齒腐壞，因此許多牙醫師希望在包裝正面加註更清楚的警告。)
The fair distribution of emergency food aid still remains difficult because roads in the north are often blocked. (緊急糧食援助的公平分配仍很困難，因為北部的道路經常中斷。)

meaning: n. 缺點；瑕疵 vi. 叛變
example: A small defect in the wiring caused the machine to stop every few hours. (配線上一點小瑕疵，就讓這台機器每隔幾小時就停機。)
Local fishermen oppose the plan because the new port would destroy their grounds. (當地漁民反對這項計畫，因為新港口會破壞他們的漁場。)
National statistics suggest that regular walking reduces heart disease, yet few adults manage even thirty minutes a day. (全國統計數據顯示，規律走路能降低心臟病風險，但很少有成人每天能走三十分鐘。)
The crowded train was so hot and stuffy that several passengers stood near the doors for fresh air. (擁擠的火車又熱又悶，好幾名乘客站到車門旁呼吸新鮮空氣。)
Approximately two hundred people attended the public meeting, though the hall was designed for only half that number. (大約兩百人參加了這場公聽會，儘管禮堂原本只設計容納一半的人數。)
Forgetting one new colleague's name is excusable, but repeatedly ignoring a senior colleague's emails is simply not acceptable. (忘記一位新同事的名字情有可原，但一再忽略資深同事的電子郵件就完全不可接受。)
The council proposed turning the empty warehouse into flats, but engineers warned that the roof needed repairs first. (市議會提議把空倉庫改成住宅，但工程師警告屋頂必須先修繕。)

meaning: n. 裝飾品 vt. 裝飾
example: Small coloured paper ornaments hung from every branch, making the square look cheerful despite the grey winter weather. (每根樹枝上都掛著彩色小紙飾，讓廣場在灰暗的冬日天候中仍顯得熱鬧。)

meaning: adj. 精力充沛的；積極的
example: The children were still surprisingly energetic after the long walk, so their parents let them play outside in the garden. (走了這麼長一段路，孩子們仍出奇地精力充沛，於是父母讓他們在花園裡玩。)
Atmospheric pollution from nearby factories has slowly damaged the ancient forest, although emissions have fallen in recent years. (附近工廠排放的大氣污染已慢慢損害這片古老森林，儘管近年排放量已經下降。)

meaning: adj. 合作的 n. 合作社
example: The rural village formed a cooperative to buy solar panels together, which cut installation costs for every household. (這個鄉村組成合作社共同購買太陽能板，讓每戶人家的安裝費用都降低了。)
Old underground pipes corrode faster in soft water, so the council plans to replace them throughout the district. (老舊地下管線在軟水中腐蝕得更快，因此市議會計畫全面更換這個地區的管線。)

meaning: n. 榮譽；尊敬 vt. 尊敬；信守
example: It was an honour for the whole village when the chef won a national prize. (這位主廚贏得全國獎項，對全村來說都是榮譽。)

meaning: prep. 除……外 vt. 將……除外
example: The express train usually runs daily except on national holidays, when a slower direct bus service replaces it. (這班特快車通常每天行駛，國定假日除外，屆時會由較慢的直達巴士取代。)
This powder is soluble in cold water, which makes it easy to use outdoors. (這種粉末可溶於冷水，因此在戶外使用很方便。)
The university administration promised to answer every application within ten days, but many students still waited much longer. (大學行政單位承諾十天內回覆每份申請，但許多學生仍等了更久。)
Children concentrate better in a calm environment, which is why some schools have removed bright displays from classrooms. (孩子在安靜的環境中較能專心，因此有些學校已把教室裡鮮豔的布置撤掉。)

meaning: n. 許可證；執照 vt. 批准
example: Fishermen need a license before they can sell their catch at the market. (漁民必須有許可證，才能在市場販售漁獲。)
The outbreak underlines the urgent need for reliable clean water, especially in villages far from the main supply. (這起疫情凸顯了對可靠乾淨用水的迫切需求，尤其是在遠離主要供水系統的村莊。)
The small kitchen alarm activates automatically when smoke is detected, so residents should never carelessly disable it again. (廚房的小型警報器偵測到煙霧就會自動啟動，因此住戶不應再粗心把它關掉。)

meaning: adj. 主要的 n. 主修；專業 vi. 主修
example: The major cause of avoidable illness in the region is still untreated water, not lack of local hospitals. (這個地區可避免疾病的主要成因仍是未經處理的水，而非缺乏當地醫院。)
The contract gives no specific date for completing the repairs to the roof. (這份合約沒有明確訂出屋頂修繕完工的日期。)

meaning: n. 目標 adj. 客觀的
example: Our main objective is to finish the bridge before winter, even if the final painting has to wait. (我們的主要目標是在冬天前完成橋梁，即使最後的油漆工程得延後。)

meaning: v. 專注；集中；濃縮 n. 濃縮物
example: Heavy traffic is concentrated on two old narrow streets, so the council finally wants to open a bypass. (繁忙車流集中在兩條狹窄的舊街道上，因此市議會終於想開闢一條外環道。)

meaning: n. 衝突 vi. 衝突；牴觸
example: The daily conflict between work and family life often becomes increasingly serious when children first start full-time school. (工作與家庭生活之間的日常衝突，往往在孩子剛開始全天上學時變得越來越嚴重。)
The rural clinic keeps an antidote for snake bites, but supplies often run low during the rainy season. (這家鄉間診所備有蛇咬解毒劑，但雨季期間供應經常不足。)
Researchers discovered that the common drug works better when taken in the morning, contrary to widely accepted earlier advice. (研究人員發現這種常見藥物在早上服用效果更好，與先前廣被接受的建議相反。)
Newer technology is not necessarily more reliable, as many remote villages still depend daily on simple old radios. (較新的科技不一定更可靠，因為許多偏遠村莊每天仍依賴簡單的老收音機。)
Drought has affected almost every country on the continent during the past year. (過去一年，乾旱幾乎影響了這片大陸上的每個國家。)
Visitors can climb the turret of the castle for a view over the bay. (遊客可以爬上城堡的塔樓，眺望整個海灣。)

meaning: adj. 有彈性的；靈活的 n. 鬆緊帶
example: Farming incomes are elastic, rising quickly in good years and falling sharply in bad ones. (農業收入很有彈性，好年頭迅速上升，壞年頭則大幅下滑。)
Planting native trees along the creek should enhance water quality within a few years. (沿溪種植原生樹木，應該能在幾年內提升水質。)
A large demonstration against the new airport ended peacefully, although traffic in the city centre stopped for hours. (一場反對新機場的大型示威和平落幕，不過市中心的交通中斷了好幾個小時。)
The constant noise interrupted her study so often that she moved to the library for the final week. (不斷的噪音頻頻中斷她念書，因此最後一週她改到圖書館。)
The senior clerk was suddenly made redundant after the company quietly moved its entire paper records system online. (公司悄悄把整套檔案系統移到線上後，這位資深職員突然被裁員。)

meaning: vt. 處理不當；粗暴對待
example: The hospital mishandled private patient records, and the mistake was only discovered later during an official internal inspection. (醫院處理病人隱私紀錄不當，這個錯誤直到後來一次官方稽查才被發現。)
The discovery of antibiotics changed medicine more than almost any other advance. (抗生素的發現，對醫學的改變幾乎勝過任何其他進展。)
Doctors advise people with liver problems to avoid alcohol completely for a year. (醫師建議有肝臟問題的人，整整一年完全避免酒精。)
The violent suppression of the uprising left deep scars that are still visible in many modern local stories. (這場起義遭到暴力鎮壓，留下深深的傷痕，至今仍可見於許多現代地方故事中。)
The rise in rents is mainly due to short-term holiday lets, not to a shortage of new homes. (租金上漲主要是短期度假租屋造成的，並非新住宅短缺。)
Property prices near the new station have risen much faster than local wages. (新車站附近的房地產價格，漲幅遠超過當地薪資。)
The hill offers a naked view of the bay, with nothing to block the wind. (這座山丘毫無遮蔽，可以望見整個海灣，也沒有東西擋風。)

meaning: n. 特徵；面貌；專題報導 v. 以……為特色
example: The phone's standout feature is its battery, which actually lasts two full days even with constant heavy use. (這支手機最突出的特徵是電池，即使持續重度使用，實際上也能撐滿兩天。)
The security camera's lens was dirty, so the footage of the entrance was too blurred to identify anyone. (監視攝影機的鏡頭髒了，因此入口的影像模糊到無法辨識任何人。)
The local volunteer coordinator matched each patient with a regular driver who could take them to hospital appointments. (當地志工協調員為每位病人安排固定的駕駛，載他們去醫院回診。)
A diet of fish and vegetables nourishes the body better than fried snacks. (魚和蔬菜的飲食，比油炸零食更能滋養身體。)

meaning: adj. 脆的；俐落的 n. 洋芋片
example: The bread stays crisp for a day if it is kept in a paper bag. (麵包放在紙袋裡，可以保持酥脆一整天。)
She felt guilty about throwing away so many leftover meals, so she started planning her weekly food shopping more carefully. (她對丟掉那麼多剩菜感到內疚，因此開始更仔細規劃每週的食材採買。)

meaning: n. 裂縫；爆裂聲 v. 破裂；崩潰
example: A crack in the dam wall was noticed by a worker during a routine check. (水壩牆面的一道裂縫，被一名工人在例行檢查時發現。)

meaning: v. 繁榮；興旺；茁壯成長
example: Local music flourished after the council opened a cheap small venue, and young bands unexpectedly found loyal audiences. (市議會開設便宜的小型場地後，當地音樂開始興旺，年輕樂團意外找到忠實觀眾。)

meaning: vt. 預訂；保留 n. 儲備；保護區
example: We reserved seats by the window, but the train company quietly changed the carriage at the last minute. (我們預訂了靠窗座位，但鐵路公司在最後一刻悄悄換了車廂。)
Designers now produce three-dimensional models before any part of the engine is manufactured. (現在設計師會先做出立體模型，才會開始製造引擎的任何零件。)
Workers spread gravel along the path so that it stays dry in winter. (工人在步道上鋪礫石，讓它在冬天保持乾燥。)
The online job advertisement clearly promised flexible hours, yet the interview revealed that weekend work was actually compulsory. (這則線上徵才廣告清楚承諾彈性工時，但面試時卻透露週末加班其實是強制的。)
Better sound insulation between the flats reduced constant noise, so neighbours above finally stopped complaining about each other. (公寓之間改善隔音後，持續的噪音減少了，樓上鄰居終於不再互相抱怨。)
After a brief hesitation, we chose the longer route, which turned out to be surprisingly much more scenic. (短暫猶豫後，我們選擇了較長的路線，結果風景出乎意料地更美。)
Regularly skipping breakfast may seriously undermine concentration, especially in teenagers whose sleep patterns are often already very poor. (經常不吃早餐可能嚴重削弱專注力，尤其是睡眠習慣往往本來就不好的青少年。)
The new filters eliminate almost all dust from the air inside the factory. (新的濾網幾乎消除了工廠內部空氣中所有的粉塵。)
The active volcano attracts thousands of hikers, although the narrow path can suddenly become dangerous after heavy rain. (這座活火山吸引數千名登山客，不過狹窄步道在大雨後可能突然變得危險。)
The price excludes meals, which the hotel charges separately at the end. (這個價格不含餐點，飯店會在最後另外收費。)
The laundry has piled up because the washing machine broke, and the local repair shop is still closed. (洗衣機壞了，待洗衣物愈堆愈多，而當地修理店仍舊沒開。)
The water is apparently safe to drink, but local residents still boil it before giving it to children. (這水似乎可以安全飲用，但當地居民仍會煮沸後才給孩子喝。)
Some sweets contain gelatin, which is why strict vegetarians often avoid them. (有些糖果含有明膠，這就是嚴格素食者常避開它們的原因。)
Lower taxes on small firms are meant to stimulate hiring in the region. (降低小企業的稅負，是為了刺激這個地區的僱用意願。)

meaning: n. 燃料 v. 加燃料；助長
example: Rising fuel costs have made long-distance commuting far less attractive for most workers. (燃料成本上漲，讓長途通勤對大多數上班族變得更不吸引人。)
The new water plant will be fully operational by the end of next month. (新的自來水廠將在下個月底全面運作。)
The airline spent millions trying to repair its image after the delays. (在連串誤點之後，這家航空公司花了數百萬試圖挽救形象。)
Volunteers distributed blankets and drinking water to families in the flooded area. (志工分發毛毯和飲用水給淹水地區的家庭。)
The notice board outside the office lists rehearsal times, exam dates and lost property waiting to be claimed. (辦公室外的佈告欄列出排練時間、考試日期，以及等待認領的失物。)
The council intends to ban cars from the square during the summer months. (市議會打算在夏季期間禁止車輛進入廣場。)

meaning: adj. 經驗主義的；實證的
example: There is little empirical evidence that primary homework actually improves understanding, although many teachers still assign it daily. (很少有實證證據顯示小學作業真能增進理解，儘管許多教師仍每天指派。)
New tenants are on short probation for three months, during which either side can quietly end the agreement. (新房客有三個月的短期試用期，期間雙方都可以默默終止合約。)

meaning: n. 憂鬱；不景氣；低氣壓
example: The seaside town suffered during the long depression, when visitors stopped coming and nearly all family hotels closed. (這座海濱小鎮在漫長的經濟不景氣中受創，遊客不再上門，幾乎所有家庭旅館都歇業。)
The proximity of the new clinic has helped older residents, who no longer need to take two buses. (新診所離得近，對年長居民很有幫助，他們不必再轉兩趟公車。)
The campaign drew public attention to loneliness among older men, and local groups soon began offering weekly lunches. (這場活動讓大眾關注年長男性的孤獨問題，地方團體很快開始提供每週共餐。)
The documentary is carefully factual but dull, so few young viewers stay until the end despite its important subject. (這部紀錄片謹守事實卻很乏味，因此儘管主題重要，少有年輕觀眾看到最後。)

meaning: vt. 讚揚；歡呼 n. 讚譽
example: The novel received widespread critical acclaim, yet it sold fewer than a thousand copies in its first year. (這本小說廣受評論界讚譽，但第一年銷量卻不到一千本。)
The pipeline carries gas directly across the mountains, supplying several remote towns that have no other winter fuel. (這條管線直接輸送天然氣穿越山區，供應幾個沒有其他冬季燃料的偏遠城鎮。)
The fire devastated the central market, destroying family stalls that had served the entire community for over fifty years. (大火摧毀了中央市場，也毀掉服務整個社區超過五十年的家族攤位。)
The response to the public flood appeal was generous, with donations arriving from towns hundreds of miles away. (民眾對水災募款的反應很踴躍，捐款從數百英里外的城鎮源源送來。)
Delivery drivers rely on the postcode, but in rural areas it can sometimes cover several miles of road. (送貨司機依賴郵遞區號，但在鄉下，一個郵遞區號有時涵蓋好幾英里的道路。)
The training was rather dull, yet the brief practical exercises at the end were actually surprisingly useful to everyone. (這場訓練相當乏味，不過最後簡短的實作練習其實意外地有用。)
Local rents are reviewed on a yearly basis, which gives tenants little protection when prices often rise suddenly. (當地租金每年檢討一次，這讓房客在價格突然上漲時幾乎沒有保障。)
Tropical diseases once common in hotter regions are spreading into cooler areas, which worries doctors who have never treated them. (曾常見於炎熱地區的熱帶疾病正蔓延到較涼爽的地區，讓從未治療過這類疾病的醫師很憂心。)
Rumours about job cuts spread through the factory long before any announcement. (早在正式宣布之前，裁員的謠言就在工廠裡傳開。)
The research was a major joint endeavour between two universities, and its successful results were eventually published openly. (這項研究是兩所大學的重要共同努力，其成功結果最後也公開發表。)

meaning: n. 地址；演說 vt. 處理；向……講話
example: The report clearly addresses the widening gap between rich and poor schools but unfortunately offers few practical solutions. (這份報告清楚處理了貧富學校之間日益擴大的差距，可惜幾乎沒有提出實際的解決方案。)
Monthly online payment is now standard, yet some older local customers still prefer to pay at the counter. (每月線上付款現在已是常態，但一些年長的當地顧客仍偏好到櫃檯付款。)
The view from the ridge was superb, though the climb took three tiring hours. (山稜上的景色極好，雖然爬上來花了累人的三小時。)
Her intention was to work abroad for two years, then return home. (她的意圖是在國外工作兩年，然後回國。)
The experiment demonstrates that children learn faster when they explain ideas to classmates rather than simply memorise facts. (這項實驗證明，孩子向同學解釋想法時，學習速度比單純背誦事實更快。)
Climate change topped the agenda at the summit, although several poorer nations argued that debt relief mattered more. (氣候變遷是這場高峰會議程的首要項目，儘管幾個較貧窮國家主張債務減免更重要。)
New lamps illuminate the riverside path so people can walk home safely. (新路燈照亮了河邊的步道，讓大家能安全走路回家。)

meaning: adj. 苗條的；薄的 vi. 變苗條
example: She stays slim by cycling to work instead of taking the bus. (她靠騎自行車上班而不搭公車，保持身材苗條。)

meaning: v. 保證；使……有正當理由 n. 授權；許可證
example: The damage is serious enough to warrant a full inspection of the roof. (損壞程度嚴重到足以構成全面檢查屋頂的理由。)
There is cautious optimism that the harvest will recover after two dry years. (大家抱持審慎樂觀的看法，認為在兩年乾旱後收成會回升。)

meaning: n. 等級；軍銜 v. 排列；評定等級
example: Hospitals in the region are ranked by how quickly patients are seen in emergencies. (這個地區的醫院，依急診病患看診的速度評定等級。)
The health crisis has added a new dimension to the debate on city planning. (這場健康危機為都市規劃的討論增添了新的面向。)

meaning: v. 有助於；有用 n. 效用
example: Extra training will not avail if the equipment itself is out of date. (如果設備本身已經過時，額外的訓練也沒有用。)
Concrete production releases huge amounts of carbon dioxide, so architects are testing new timber and recycled materials instead. (混凝土生產會釋放大量二氧化碳，因此建築師正改為測試新木材和回收材料。)

meaning: n. 街區；障礙物 vt. 阻塞；封鎖
example: The new bakery is three blocks away, next to a small post office. (新的麵包店在三個街區外，就在一家小郵局旁邊。)
Most routine administrative work at the school is now done online, which saves teachers several hours each week. (學校大多數例行行政工作現在都改在線上處理，每週替教師省下好幾個小時。)
Slow internet is deeply frustrating for remote workers, especially when daily video calls freeze during important client meetings. (網路慢讓遠距工作者非常沮喪，尤其是每天視訊通話在重要客戶會議中卡住時。)

meaning: adj. 抵抗的；有抵抗力的
example: Some bacteria are resistant to several common antibiotics, which is why doctors now prescribe them far more cautiously. (有些細菌對好幾種常用抗生素具抵抗力，因此醫師現在開藥謹慎得多。)
The long overdue train was finally announced, but the platform had changed suddenly without any clear public explanation. (誤點很久的火車終於廣播了，但月台突然更改，卻沒有任何清楚的公開說明。)
The hospital's recovery rate is impressive, yet staff insist that early diagnosis matters more than new surgical equipment. (這家醫院的康復率令人印象深刻，但員工堅稱早期診斷比新外科設備更重要。)
Careful analysis of the local river samples revealed traces of pesticide, prompting officials to warn nearby farmers immediately. (仔細分析當地河水樣本後發現農藥殘留，促使官員立即警告附近農民。)
The final verdict surprised everyone, as the evidence had seemed very clearly to favour the defending local champion. (最終判決讓所有人意外，因為證據似乎明顯有利於衛冕的當地冠軍。)
Older drivers must take a short refresher course after a certain age, though many resent the extra cost. (年長駕駛到一定年齡後必須參加短期複習課程，不過許多人對額外費用很不滿。)

meaning: v. 熊熊燃燒 n. 火焰
example: The fire blazed for six hours before crews brought it under control. (大火燒了六個小時，消防人員才控制住。)
Farmers misjudged the early frost and lost most of the fruit, which pushed prices up across the region. (農民誤判提早到來的霜害，損失大部分水果，導致整個地區價格上漲。)
Pregnant workers are entitled to extra breaks and to changes in their working hours. (懷孕的員工有權獲得額外休息時間，並調整工作時數。)

meaning: adj. 頑強的；堅硬的；不屈的
example: The team's unyielding defence frustrated opponents throughout the entire match, especially those who had expected an easy victory. (這支球隊頑強的防守讓對手整場比賽都很挫折，尤其是原本以為能輕鬆獲勝的隊伍。)

meaning: adj. 外部的 n. 外部；外表
example: The exterior of the museum is plain, but the inside is full of light. (這座博物館的外表樸素，但內部卻充滿光線。)
The committee approved the new reading curriculum, but asked teachers to report fully on its progress every term. (委員會批准了新的閱讀課程，但要求教師每學期完整回報實施進度。)
The clinic's newest client is a large local employer that wants health checks for all its delivery drivers. (這家診所最新的客戶是當地一家大型僱主，想為所有送貨司機安排健康檢查。)

meaning: n. 方言；本地話 adj. 方言的
example: The poet wrote in the local vernacular, which made his work accessible to farmers who had little schooling. (這位詩人以當地方言寫作，讓受教育不多的農民也能讀懂他的作品。)
It is difficult to compare local hospitals fairly, because they simply treat patients with very different needs and budgets. (要公平比較當地醫院很困難，因為它們服務的病人需求和預算差異很大。)
It was transparent that the decision had been made before the meeting began. (很明顯，這個決定在會議開始前就已經做好了。)

meaning: n. 卡式錄音帶；卡式錄影帶
example: He still plays cassettes recorded in the 1980s on an old player. (他還在用一台舊機器播放 1980 年代錄的卡式錄音帶。)
The deputy took charge of the office while the manager was abroad. (經理出國期間，副手負責辦公室的事務。)
Online card fraud has risen sharply, so banks now send warnings whenever a large payment looks suddenly unusual. (線上信用卡詐欺大幅增加，因此只要大筆付款突然顯得異常，銀行就會發出警告。)
The contract binds both companies to keep all the details of the deal confidential. (這份合約約束雙方公司，必須對交易的所有細節保密。)
The fragrance of jasmine fills the street on warm evenings in spring. (春天溫暖的傍晚，茉莉的芳香瀰漫整條街。)
The online marketplace allows small craftspeople to still reach overseas customers directly without paying rent for a shop. (這個線上集市讓小型手工業者仍能直接接觸海外顧客，不必付店面租金。)

meaning: adj. 急性的；敏銳的；劇烈的
example: The hospital treats acute injuries immediately, but other cases wait for hours. (醫院會立即處理急性傷害，其他病例則要等好幾小時。)
The tomatoes grown here are ripe only in the warmest weeks of summer. (這裡種的番茄，只有在夏天最熱的幾週才會成熟。)

meaning: vt. 審查 n. 獸醫
example: Every supplier is vetted before the restaurant agrees to buy from them. (餐廳同意向任何供應商採購之前，都會先審查過。)
The committee spent six months formulating a clear policy on short-term rentals. (委員會花了六個月，規劃出一套明確的短期租屋政策。)
The team carefully collated survey results from twelve schools before writing a short final report for the ministry. (團隊仔細整理十二所學校的調查結果，之後才為部會撰寫簡短的最終報告。)
From the low sales, we can infer that the product is too expensive. (從銷售低迷可以推斷，這項產品價格太高。)
The library keeps modern fiction on the ground floor, where older readers can comfortably browse a wide selection. (圖書館把現代小說放在一樓，讓年長讀者能舒適地瀏覽豐富的藏書。)
Her ability to stay calm under pressure impressed the senior coach, who had doubted her before the match. (她在壓力下保持冷靜的能力讓資深教練印象深刻，這位教練賽前還曾懷疑她。)
The health sector now employs more local people than the factories once did. (醫療產業現在雇用的人數，比過去的工廠還多。)
The cat slowly crept along the wooden fence, watching some small birds quietly gather around the garden feeder. (貓沿著木圍欄慢慢潛行，盯著小鳥悄悄聚集在花園餵食器旁。)

meaning: adj. 偶然的；臨時的；非正式的
example: The office allows casual clothes on Fridays, which staff say makes the whole atmosphere generally much more relaxed. (公司允許週五穿便服，員工說這讓整體氣氛普遍輕鬆許多。)
Her original interpretation of the painting differs from the guidebook, but the curator still finds it surprisingly convincing. (她對這幅畫的獨到解釋與導覽手冊不同，但館長仍覺得意外地有說服力。)
