The school year is divided into three trimesters, with a short break between each demanding period of study. (學年分為三個學期，每段繁重的學習期間之間都有短假。)
There is growing scientific consensus that sugar should be heavily taxed, although the food industry still strongly disagrees. (科學界越來越有共識認為糖應被課重稅，儘管食品業仍強烈反對。)
The redevelopment of the old gasworks will finally provide new homes, but rents are expected to be high. (老瓦斯廠的重新開發終於將提供新住宅，但預期租金會很高。)
The school auditorium was too small for the annual concert, so the event moved to the town hall. (學校禮堂容不下年度音樂會，因此活動改到市政廳舉行。)

meaning: n. 狀況；條件 vt. 使習慣；影響
example: The patient's serious condition improved gradually after major surgery, although he still needs supplementary oxygen every single night. (病人嚴重的病況在大手術後逐漸改善，不過他每晚仍需補充氧氣。)
The charity furnished the small shelter with donated beds, tables and lamps, making it feel like a home. (慈善機構用捐贈的床、桌子和燈具布置這間小收容所，讓它像個家。)
The new breakwater helped stabilise the beach and protect the houses nearby. (新的防波堤協助穩定了海灘，並保護附近的房屋。)

meaning: adj. 進來的；新任的 n. 收入
example: Incoming flights were delayed by dense fog, so hundreds of passengers waited in the main terminal until midday. (濃霧導致進場航班延誤，數百名旅客在主航廈等到中午。)
The alignment of two rival parties surprised voters shortly before the election. (兩個對立政黨的結盟，在選前不久讓選民大感意外。)
The boot was full of plants, so we put the bags on the back seat for the journey home. (車後行李箱塞滿了植物，因此我們把袋子放在後座，一路回家。)
Banning certain chemicals helped the ozone layer begin to recover quite slowly. (禁用某些化學物質後，臭氧層開始相當緩慢地復原。)

meaning: n. 酸 adj. 酸的；尖刻的
example: A little simple acid, such as lemon juice, can brighten the strong flavour of a rich heavy sauce. (一點簡單的酸味，例如檸檬汁，就能讓濃郁厚重的醬汁味道更明亮。)

meaning: adj. 快速發展的；激增的
example: The booming university town has attracted many independent cafés and bookshops, but long-term residents now fear rising rents. (快速發展的大學城吸引了許多獨立咖啡館和書店，但長住居民現在擔心租金上漲。)
We still have no definite date for the family's removal, which makes booking a suitable van extremely difficult. (我們全家搬家仍沒有明確日期，這讓預訂合適的廂型車變得極為困難。)
The building was deemed unsafe, so tenants were moved to temporary flats. (這棟大樓被認為不安全，因此房客被安置到臨時公寓。)
The narrator's calm voice made the long historical audiobook surprisingly pleasant, even during chapters describing truly difficult journeys. (敘述者沉穩的嗓音讓這套長篇歷史有聲書意外悅耳，即使在描述真正艱難旅程的章節也是。)
After the injury, she reoriented her career towards coaching and soon found full-time work at a local club. (受傷之後，她把職涯重新定位到教練工作，很快就在當地俱樂部找到全職工作。)
I reckon the journey will normally take four hours, provided we avoid the roadworks near the old bridge. (我估計這趟路通常要四小時，只要我們避開老橋附近的道路施工。)

meaning: n. 輔導課；指南 adj. 輔導的
example: The online tutorial explains how to use the library catalogue, but many students still ask staff for help. (線上指南說明如何使用圖書館目錄，但許多學生仍向館員求助。)
Landlords often ask for a written reference from a previous tenant, which makes moving to the city difficult for newcomers. (房東常要求前一任房客的書面推薦函，這讓新來的人很難搬進城市。)

meaning: n. 雪橇 vi. 乘雪橇
example: The children pulled a small wooden sledge up the hill, then raced down together laughing until the winter sunset. (孩子們把小木雪橇拉上山丘，然後一起大笑著滑下山，直到冬日落陽。)
Some advertisements seriously exaggerate the benefits of vitamins, which often leads people to waste money on unnecessary products. (有些廣告嚴重誇大維他命的好處，往往讓人把錢浪費在不需要的產品上。)
The new restriction on hand luggage has slowed airport security checks, though passengers admit the queues feel safer. (新的隨身行李限制讓機場安檢變慢，不過旅客承認排隊時感覺比較安全。)
The builders abandoned the whole project when the funding was suddenly withdrawn. (資金突然被撤回後，建商放棄了整項計畫。)
Repairing the leak is the top priority before the wet season starts. (在雨季開始前，修好漏水是最優先的事。)
The narrow dark cellar completely terrified him as a child, and he still avoids going down there alone. (那間狹窄陰暗的地窖在他小時候把他嚇壞了，他到現在仍不敢獨自下去。)
Building the new road will destroy the remaining habitat of several small rare butterflies, according to local naturalists. (當地自然學家指出，興建新道路將摧毀幾種稀有蝴蝶僅存的棲息地。)
Free fruit in schools encourages children to try new foods, although habits at home matter just as much. (學校提供免費水果能鼓勵孩子嘗試新食物，不過家裡的飲食習慣同樣重要。)
A local celebrity unexpectedly endorsed the charity's online campaign, and donations rose sharply within just a single week. (一位當地名人意外為慈善機構的線上活動站台，捐款在短短一週內大幅增加。)
The letters are of great historical significance because they clearly describe ordinary daily life during the long siege. (這些信件具有重大的歷史意義，因為它們清楚描述漫長圍城期間的日常平民生活。)

meaning: adj. 磁性的；有吸引力的
example: The lid stays shut because of a magnetic strip inside the frame. (因為框內有一條磁條，蓋子會一直吸附關上。)
The steps become slippery after rain, so a handrail was added last year. (下雨後階梯會變滑，因此去年加裝了扶手。)
The witness gave a graphic account of the flood that swept through the village. (那位證人生動描述了沖過村莊的那場洪水。)
Doctors examined the small X-ray carefully but found no fracture, so they simply advised rest instead of surgery. (醫師仔細查看這張小型 X 光片，但沒發現骨折，因此只建議休息，不必動手術。)
The harbour expansion gave local firms an opportunity to win overseas contracts. (港口擴建讓本地企業有機會贏得海外合約。)
It is hard to distinguish the two brands, since both use similar packaging. (這兩個品牌很難區別，因為兩者包裝很相似。)
We spread an old blanket under the tree and watched the children chase each other across the grass. (我們在樹下鋪了一條舊毯子，看著孩子們在草地上互相追逐。)
His arrogance towards junior staff cost him the support he badly needed. (他對基層員工的傲慢，讓他失去了急需的支持。)
The era of printed railway timetables is quietly ending, as even small stations now direct passengers to apps. (紙本鐵路時刻表的時代正悄悄結束，因為連小車站現在都引導乘客使用應用程式。)
Lower interest rates acted as a stimulus for small businesses to borrow. (較低的利率成為小企業借貸的促進因素。)
Visitors may roam freely through the large gardens, but they must stay on the clearly marked paths after sunset. (遊客可以在廣大花園裡自由漫遊，但日落後必須走在清楚標示的步道上。)
The outdoor event will go ahead provided the local council grants permission and the field remains reasonably dry. (只要地方議會批准，而且場地保持相當乾燥，這場戶外活動就會如期舉行。)
A recent comparison of the two treatments clearly showed that the cheaper one often worked equally well in patients. (最近一項比較兩種療程的研究清楚顯示，較便宜的那種對病人往往同樣有效。)
The bakery gained free publicity when a food blogger praised its daily bread, and queues soon formed outside. (一位美食部落客稱讚這家麵包店的每日麵包後，店家獲得免費宣傳，門外很快排起人龍。)
Whether the harvest succeeds depends increasingly on the weather, so farmers now pay for accurate detailed summer forecasts. (收成能否成功越來越取決於天氣，因此農民現在願意付費取得準確詳細的夏季預報。)
The composition blends local traditional melodies with electronic sounds, which surprises young audiences expecting a purely classical piece. (這首曲子融合當地傳統旋律與電子音效，讓期待純古典作品的年輕觀眾很驚訝。)

meaning: n. 建築學；建築風格；架構
example: The traditional architecture of the desert town uses thick walls and small windows to keep rooms naturally cool. (這座沙漠城鎮的傳統建築風格採用厚牆和小窗，讓室內自然涼爽。)

meaning: n. 障礙；跨欄 v. 跨越
example: The biggest hurdle for returning mature university students is often the cost of childcare, not the entrance exam. (對重返校園的成年大學生來說，最大的障礙往往是托育費用，而非入學考試。)
Good teamwork in the operating theatre saves lives, yet hospitals rarely train staff together as a single team. (手術室裡良好的團隊合作能救命，但醫院很少把員工當成單一團隊一起訓練。)

meaning: adj. 潮溼的 n. 溼氣 vt. 使潮溼；抑制
example: The walls feel damp because the ground outside stays wet all winter. (牆壁摸起來溼溼的，因為外面的土壤整個冬天都是濕的。)

meaning: n. 全體員工 vt. 配備人員
example: The hotel trains its staff to handle complaints before they reach the manager. (這家飯店訓練員工在申訴傳到經理之前就先處理好。)

meaning: adj. 易於……的；適切的；敏捷的
example: Older wooden boats are apt to leak if they are left out of water. (老舊的木船如果離開水面太久，很容易漏水。)
The suburb is far from homogeneous, since families from many countries live there. (這個郊區絕非同質，因為來自許多國家的家庭都住在那裡。)
Simple changes at home can conserve both water and electricity quite cheaply. (在家做點簡單改變，就能以很低的成本同時節約水和電。)
A sudden spasm in his back made it painful to stand up. (背部突然一陣痙攣，讓他站起來就很痛。)
Air pollution is often invisible, which makes the problem easy to ignore. (空氣污染往往看不見，這讓問題容易被忽略。)
She devoted ten years of her career to studying coastal erosion, often working quietly alone on remote northern beaches. (她把職涯中的十年奉獻給海岸侵蝕研究，經常獨自在偏遠的北方海灘默默工作。)
The chart illustrates how average temperatures in the city have risen since 1980. (這張圖表說明了這座城市的平均氣溫自 1980 年以來如何上升。)

meaning: n. 梯田；陽臺；露天平臺
example: We had breakfast on the terrace while looking out over the harbour. (我們在陽臺上吃早餐，同時眺望海港的景色。)

meaning: adj. 動力的；充滿活力的
example: The neighbourhood has a dynamic local arts scene, with new small galleries opening in former shops every month. (這個社區有充滿活力的地方藝術圈，每個月都有新藝廊在前身是商店的空間開幕。)

meaning: prep. 遍及；貫穿整個…… adv. 各處；自始至終
example: Rural clinics throughout the island now offer free screening, although waiting times still remain long in remote villages. (全島的鄉村診所現在都提供免費篩檢，不過偏遠村莊的等候時間仍很長。)
A smart city traffic system could reduce congestion, but only if drivers trust the signs it clearly displays. (聰明的城市交通系統能減少壅塞，但前提是駕駛人信任它清楚顯示的標誌。)
Local residents criticised the council for approving the tower without public consultation. (當地居民批評市議會未經公眾諮詢就批准這座高樓。)
The demand for evening classes went beyond what the college had expected, forcing it to hire more tutors. (夜間課程的需求超出學院的預期，迫使學院聘請更多教師。)
Tourists rarely visit the hinterland, although its quiet villages and old churches are well worth the long journey. (遊客很少走訪內地，儘管當地寧靜的村莊和古老教堂很值得這趟長途旅程。)
Diesel fumes from the daily school buses have raised serious concerns among nearby parents about children's lung health. (每天接送學生的巴士排放柴油廢氣，讓附近家長嚴重關切孩子的肺部健康。)

meaning: adj. 肯定的；積極的；明確的
example: The early trial produced unexpectedly positive results, though doctors still remain cautious because the sample was very small. (早期試驗出現意外正面的結果，不過醫師仍提醒樣本數非常少。)

meaning: adj. 助理的 n. 助理；助手
example: The research assistant checked every figure twice, yet a small error still slipped into the published final table. (研究助理把每個數字核對兩次，但一個小錯誤仍溜進已發表的最終表格。)
The old cannon in the museum garden was fired only on special occasions, according to the official guidebook. (根據官方導覽手冊，博物館花園裡的舊大炮只在特殊場合才會鳴放。)
Employers have an obligation to provide safe equipment for everyone on site. (雇主有義務為工地上的每個人提供安全的設備。)
The local hockey club trains twice a week and plays matches on Sundays. (當地的曲棍球俱樂部每週訓練兩次，週日比賽。)
The citizens fought for personal liberty, yet the new rulers soon restricted basic freedom of assembly and speech. (市民為個人自由而奮鬥，但新統治者很快就限制集會與言論的基本自由。)
Harmful pesticide residues were found on the affected fruit, prompting the supermarket to quickly remove the entire batch. (受影響的水果被驗出有害農藥殘留，促使超市迅速下架整批貨品。)

meaning: n. 民意調查；投票 v. 調查；獲得選票
example: A recent poll found that most hospital nurses would strongly support shorter shifts, even with slightly lower pay. (最近一項民調發現，多數醫院護理師強烈支持縮短班表，即使薪水略低也願意。)
The ticket is refundable only if the concert is cancelled, so always check the terms carefully before booking. (這張票只有在演唱會取消時才可退款，因此訂票前一定要仔細查看條款。)
International students often feel particularly homesick at weekends, when classes suddenly stop and their rooms seem very quiet. (國際學生在週末往往特別想家，因為課程突然停止，房間也顯得格外安靜。)
A compassionate approach to homelessness clearly works better than fines, according to workers who run the local shelter. (根據經營當地收容所的工作人員表示，以同理心處理無家可歸問題，顯然比罰款有效。)
The university runs a week of activities to orientate new students, including short tours and free language help. (大學舉辦一週活動幫助新生適應，包括簡短校園導覽和免費語言協助。)

meaning: n. 洞察力；深刻的理解
example: Talking to long-term residents gave the planners real insight into local needs. (與長期居民交談，讓規劃人員真正了解當地的需求。)
Children often resist going to bed early, even when they are clearly tired and their parents firmly insist. (孩子常常抗拒早睡，即使他們明顯累了，父母也堅定要求。)

meaning: vi. 滑行；滑翔 n. 滑行
example: The ferry glided quietly into the harbour just before the storm broke. (渡輪在暴風雨來臨前悄悄滑進港口。)

meaning: n. 傷亡人員；傷亡事故
example: The new safety rules have reduced the number of casualties on building sites. (新的安全規定降低了建築工地的傷亡人數。)
A strong belief in local produce drew customers to her small shop. (對本地農產品的堅定信念，為她的小店帶來顧客。)
High concentrations of salt in the soil prevent most crops from growing well. (土壤中高濃度的鹽分，讓大部分作物無法好好生長。)
Two workers tugged hard on the rope until the boat touched the shore. (兩名工人用力拉著繩索，直到船靠上岸。)
Work on the new library will proceed once the old pipes have been safely removed from the site. (等舊管線安全地從工地移除後，新圖書館的工程就會繼續進行。)
The status of the building project changes every week as funding is reviewed. (隨著資金不斷檢討，這項建築計畫的狀況每週都在變。)

meaning: n. 文件；證件 vt. 記錄
example: Keep your important travel documents in a safe place, since replacing a lost passport normally takes several days. (把重要旅行文件放在安全的地方，因為補辦遺失護照通常要花好幾天。)
The hotel replaced every old mattress last spring, and guests soon noticed that they slept far more comfortably. (這家飯店去年春天把舊床墊全部換掉，房客很快發現睡起來舒服多了。)
The angry meeting turned hostile when residents suddenly learned that the factory would not fund the local cleanup. (居民突然得知工廠不願出資清理當地環境時，原本憤怒的會議氣氛變得充滿敵意。)
The government had to intervene in the market when the price of bread doubled. (當麵包價格翻倍時，政府不得不介入市場。)
The campaign promotes daily walking to school, hoping both to reduce local traffic and improve children's overall fitness. (這項活動推廣每天走路上學，希望同時減少當地車流並增進整體健康。)

meaning: v. 碰撞；顛簸前進 n. 碰撞；隆起
example: The hard suitcase bumped against the escalator, but the small laptop's screen inside still survived without any damage. (硬殼行李箱撞到電扶梯，但裡面的筆電螢幕仍毫髮無傷。)
The family reunion was held at a lakeside restaurant, where relatives met distant cousins they had never seen. (家族聚會在湖畔餐廳舉行，親戚們在那裡見到從未謀面的遠房表親。)
Short gentle walking after meals can aid the digestive system, though many people simply prefer to lie down. (飯後短暫溫和地散步有助消化系統，不過許多人就是寧願躺下來。)
The homestay included breakfast and a bicycle, which let us explore the quiet village without hiring a car. (這間寄宿家庭包含早餐和腳踏車，讓我們不必租車就能探索寧靜的村莊。)
The company has committed to cutting plastic waste, but campaigners doubt that the strict deadline will be met. (這家公司已承諾減少塑膠廢棄物，但倡議人士懷疑能否趕上嚴格的期限。)
Practically every household in the valley now has electricity and a phone line. (山谷裡幾乎每一戶人家現在都有電力和電話線。)

meaning: n. 雜技演員；特技演員
example: The young acrobat performed above the crowd without a net, which clearly made several parents look away nervously. (年輕雜技演員在沒有安全網的情況下於觀眾上方表演，明顯讓幾位家長緊張地別過頭。)
Ticket revenue alone cannot fund the local stadium, so the club also sells advertising space and annual memberships. (光靠門票收入無法支撐這座地方體育場，因此球團也販售廣告空間和年度會員。)
Nickel is used in batteries, which makes its price important for carmakers. (鎳用於電池，這使得它的價格對車廠很重要。)

meaning: adj. 軟的；無力的 vi. 跛行
example: The flowers looked limp after two days without water, but they quickly recovered once we soaked the soil. (花兒缺水兩天後顯得軟垂，但我們把土壤澆透後，它們很快就恢復了。)

meaning: v. 吐（唾沫）；噴出 n. 唾液
example: The old engine spits out a cloud of smoke whenever it starts. (這台老引擎每次發動都會噴出一團煙。)
The heart scan revealed a small unexpected irregularity in her heartbeat, so the doctor immediately ordered further tests. (心臟掃描發現她的心跳有輕微而意外的異常，因此醫師立即安排進一步檢查。)
A cool breeze from the sea makes the evening market pleasant to walk through. (一陣涼爽的海風，讓傍晚的市場走起來很舒服。)
Volunteering abroad is one avenue to gain experience before a career change. (到國外當志工，是轉行前累積經驗的一條途徑。)
Cheap lenses magnify the image but often blur the edges of the picture. (便宜的鏡頭會放大影像，但常讓畫面邊緣模糊。)

meaning: n. 蜂巢；蜂箱；繁忙之處
example: The school installed a hive on the roof, and pupils now quietly study bees without leaving the building. (學校在屋頂設置蜂箱，學生現在不必離開校舍就能安靜觀察蜜蜂。)
Engineers added a thin layer of oxide to stop the metal from rusting. (工程師加上一層薄薄的氧化物，防止金屬生鏽。)
A calf born in the spring needs milk and shelter for several months. (春天出生的小牛，需要喝奶並有遮蔽處好幾個月。)
Safety is the foremost concern when crews work on high-voltage power lines. (工作人員在高壓電線上作業時，安全是最重要的考量。)
The procedure for reporting an accident is posted on the wall of every workshop. (意外通報的程序，張貼在每間工作坊的牆上。)
Volunteers assembled the new playground equipment in a single morning, although all the printed instructions looked fairly complicated. (志工在一個上午就組裝好新遊樂設備，儘管印刷說明看起來相當複雜。)
The editor resigned after clear plagiarism was found in three articles, and the paper published a full apology. (三篇文章被查出明顯抄襲後，編輯辭職，報社也刊登了完整道歉。)
We watched wild horses gallop across the distant plain, their dust glowing in the golden late afternoon sun. (我們看著野馬奔馳過遠方平原，揚起的塵土在午後金黃陽光中閃耀。)

meaning: v. 保證；發誓 n. 誓言；保證
example: The mayor pledged to build more affordable homes, but critics note that no land has yet been chosen. (市長保證興建更多平價住宅，但批評者指出，至今仍未選定任何土地。)
Small class sizes are genuinely effective only when teachers receive regular professional training and adequate planning support each term. (小班制唯有在教師獲得定期專業訓練和足夠備課支援時，才真正有效。)
Staff genuinely appreciate flexible working hours, yet some managers worry that office teamwork suffers when people rarely meet. (員工真心感激彈性工時，但有些主管擔心大家很少碰面會影響辦公室團隊合作。)
The player firmly denied cheating, but the slow video replay clearly showed his hand deliberately touching the ball. (這名球員堅決否認作弊，但慢動作重播清楚顯示他的手刻意碰球。)
The local union warned that staff shortages could permanently close the clinic unless more nurses were quickly hired. (當地工會警告，除非增聘更多護理師，人手不足可能讓診所永久關閉。)
Caring for the river is a shared responsibility, so farmers and factories must both reduce their polluting waste. (照顧這條河是共同責任，因此農民和工廠都必須減少污染性廢棄物。)
New buildings must conform to strict rules about insulation and fire safety. (新建築必須符合隔熱和消防安全的嚴格規定。)

meaning: adj. 方便的；手邊的；手巧的
example: A small folding umbrella is handy in this city, where rain can suddenly start without any warning at all. (在這座城市，小雨傘很方便，因為雨可能毫無預警地突然下起來。)
The airline will notify passengers by text if the flight is cancelled. (如果班機取消，航空公司會以簡訊通知乘客。)
The view from the lighthouse is splendid at sunset, especially in autumn. (日落時從燈塔望出去的景色很壯麗，秋天尤其如此。)

meaning: n. 方向；指導；用法說明
example: Read the direction on the packet before you apply the chemical to the plants. (在把藥劑用在植物上之前，請先閱讀包裝上的用法說明。)
The team executed the plan so carefully that nobody noticed the change. (團隊執行這項計畫非常仔細，沒有人察覺到變動。)

meaning: n. 目擊者；證人 v. 目擊；見證
example: A witness described the lorry as it turned into the narrow street. (一名目擊者描述了那輛卡車轉進窄街時的情況。)

meaning: n. 手肘；彎頭 v. 用肘推
example: He injured his elbow while lifting heavy boxes at the warehouse last week. (他上週在倉庫搬重箱子時傷到了手肘。)
Places on the popular course are limited, so applicants are strongly advised to apply several months in advance. (這門熱門課程名額有限，因此強烈建議申請者提前幾個月報名。)
A large cargo vessel slowly entered the harbour at dawn, carrying parts for the new offshore wind farm. (一艘大型貨船在黎明時緩緩進港，載著新離岸風場的零件。)

meaning: adj. 私人的；私下的；私立的
example: Private clinics often charge considerably more, yet many wealthy patients still choose them because waiting times are shorter. (私人診所收費往往高得多，但許多富裕病人仍選擇它們，因為等候時間較短。)

meaning: adj. 立體聲的 n. 立體聲音響
example: He still keeps an old stereo that once belonged to his father. (他還留著一台曾經屬於他父親的舊立體聲音響。)
Soak the beans overnight, or they will take several hours to cook. (豆子要浸泡一夜，否則要煮好幾個小時。)

meaning: adj. 肥胖的；結實的；頑強的
example: He wore a pair of stout boots for the long walk, which protected his ankles on the rough rocky path. (他穿結實的靴子走這趟長路，在崎嶇多石的小徑上保護了腳踝。)
Greasy food is cheap and filling, yet it leaves many office workers feeling quickly tired by mid afternoon. (油膩食物便宜又吃得飽，卻讓許多上班族到了下午就很快覺得疲倦。)
The manager proudly boasted about the team's sales figures, but nobody mentioned the customers who had quietly left. (經理得意地誇耀團隊的銷售數字，卻沒人提到那些默默流失的顧客。)
The council took swift action to close the bridge after cracks appeared. (橋面出現裂縫後，市議會迅速採取行動封閉橋樑。)
Public ignorance about recycling is one reason so much plastic is thrown away. (大眾對回收的無知，是大量塑膠被丟棄的原因之一。)
The changes were made for aesthetic reasons rather than to improve safety. (這些改動是基於美學考量，而不是為了提升安全。)

meaning: n. 螢幕；屏風 vt. 篩選；遮蔽；放映
example: All blood donors are carefully screened for infection, which makes transfusions now far safer than they once were. (所有捐血者都經過仔細篩檢感染，這讓輸血現在比以往安全得多。)

meaning: adj. 缺席的；心不在焉的
example: Three pupils were absent from the important exam, so the teacher quickly arranged a separate test next week. (三名學生缺席重要考試，因此老師很快安排下週另行補考。)

meaning: v. 刮；擦 n. 擦傷
example: He scraped the ice off the windscreen with an old plastic card. (他用一張舊塑膠卡把擋風玻璃上的冰刮掉。)
The airline's winter promotion cut return fares by nearly half, but passengers soon discovered that luggage cost extra. (航空公司的冬季促銷把來回票價砍了將近一半，但乘客很快發現行李要另外付費。)
The old railway line is now used for recreation, with cyclists and daily walkers sharing a narrow path. (舊鐵道現在供休閒使用，自行車族和每日散步的民眾共用一條狹窄步道。)
The firm specialises in environmental waste cases, and it has successfully won several recent disputes against local factories. (這家事務所專攻環境案件，最近已成功打贏幾場對當地工廠的訴訟。)
The view from the summit was magnificent, although the path had been crowded with noisy tourists all morning. (山頂的景色非常壯麗，儘管整條步道整個上午都擠滿吵鬧的遊客。)
Spasmodic bursts of heavy rain made the harvest very unpredictable this year. (一陣陣間歇的豪雨，讓今年的收成難以預測。)

meaning: n. 基金；資金 vt. 資助
example: The city funded free bus travel for pensioners on weekday mornings last year. (這座城市去年資助長者在平日上午免費搭公車。)
Many drivers still perceive cycling as dangerous, even on quiet side streets. (許多駕駛人認為騎自行車很危險，即使在安靜的巷道上也一樣。)
The manufacturer recalled the lamps after several customers reported smoke from them. (在幾位顧客反映燈具冒煙後，製造商召回這批燈。)
The tiles were rejected because they did not match the agreed specification. (這批磁磚因為不符合議定的規格而被退回。)

meaning: n. 時刻表；日程 v. 安排
example: The train schedule changes in December, so busy commuters should carefully check times before travelling during the holidays. (火車時刻表十二月會調整，因此忙碌的通勤族在假期出行前應仔細確認時間。)
The new flexible work arrangement lets staff start early, provided they still attend the daily morning meeting online. (新的彈性工作安排讓員工可以提早開始，前提是仍要線上參加每日晨會。)
The destruction of the city walls began in the nineteenth century, when space was needed for new roads. (城牆的破壞始於十九世紀，當時需要騰出空間興建新道路。)
A fire extinguisher must be checked every year and kept near the door. (滅火器每年都必須檢查，並放在門邊。)
Doctors often assume that patients regularly take their medicine as prescribed, yet studies show that many simply forget. (醫師常假定病人會按指示規律服藥，但研究顯示許多人根本忘了吃。)
A large proportion of the village now works in the city and comes home only at weekends. (村裡很大一部分的人現在都在城裡工作，只有週末才回家。)
She stepped forth to answer the important question, although her voice shook nervously in front of the audience. (她站出來回答這個重要問題，儘管一開始聲音緊張得發抖。)

meaning: n. 裁判；仲裁人 v. 裁判
example: The referee consulted the video before awarding the final penalty, which still angered the visiting team and their fans. (裁判在判十二碼前查看影片，但這仍讓客隊和球迷很生氣。)
She chose to forgo her daily lunch break so that the important report could be finished on time. (她選擇放棄每天的午休，好讓重要報告能準時完成。)

meaning: n. 研究生助教獎學金
example: The assistantship covers full tuition and pays a small monthly stipend, but it requires twenty hours of laboratory work. (這份助教獎學金支付全額學費，每月還有一小筆津貼，但每週必須做二十小時實驗室工作。)
Their quiet conversation about local house prices seemed almost endless long after the coffee had gone completely cold. (他們輕聲談著當地房價，咖啡完全涼了之後，話題似乎還沒完沒了。)
A strong recommendation from her previous supervisor helped her secure the full-time job, even though she lacked formal experience. (前主管一封有力的推薦信幫她拿到這份全職工作，儘管她缺乏正式經驗。)
The graph clearly shows local infection rates falling gradually after the vaccination programme finally began in rural districts. (這張圖表清楚顯示，疫苗接種計畫終於在鄉村地區展開後，當地感染率逐漸下降。)
The company planted trees to offset the carbon produced by its delivery vans. (公司種樹來抵消貨車排放的碳。)

meaning: n. 人類；人性；人文學科
example: Climate change is often described as the greatest challenge facing humanity this century. (氣候變遷常被形容為本世紀人類面臨的最大挑戰。)

meaning: adj. 完整無缺的；完好無損的
example: The old temple survived the earthquake, and its painted ceiling is still intact. (這座老廟挺過了地震，彩繪天花板依然完整無缺。)
Each zebra has a unique pattern of narrow stripes, which helps researchers clearly identify individuals in the wild. (每隻斑馬都有獨特的細條紋圖案，這有助研究人員在野外清楚辨識個別斑馬。)
A mechanical failure suddenly stopped the factory's main conveyor, so production halted for most of the whole shift. (機械故障突然讓工廠主要輸送帶停擺，因此整個班次大部分時間生產都中斷。)
Turn left at the junction where the bakery stands, and you will see the park. (在麵包店所在的交叉口左轉，就會看到公園。)
A short siesta after lunch improves afternoon concentration, according to a study of office workers in southern Europe. (根據一項針對南歐上班族的研究，午餐後短暫午睡能提升下午的專注力。)
The app can detect subtle changes in your voice and warn you when early symptoms of illness appear. (這款應用程式能察覺聲音的細微變化，並在疾病早期症狀出現時警告你。)

meaning: n. 繞道；便道 v. 繞道
example: Road works forced us to take a long detour through the hills. (道路施工迫使我們繞道，穿過山區走了一大段遠路。)
The narrow staircase at the back of the house leads to a small attic. (屋子後方的窄樓梯通往一間小閣樓。)
Arthritis forced him to give up gardening, though he still grows herbs in small pots on the balcony. (關節炎迫使他放棄園藝，不過他仍在陽台的小盆栽裡種香草。)
The wide river is a natural barrier, so the new bridge should finally cut journey times for nearby villages considerably. (這條寬闊的河流是天然障礙，因此新橋終於應能大幅縮短附近村莊的車程。)
Robots may replace routine factory jobs, but they also create new roles that increasingly demand different technical skills. (機器人可能取代例行的工廠工作，但也創造出越來越需要不同技術能力的新職務。)
The families waited twenty years for justice after the factory poisoned their river. (工廠毒害他們的河川後，這些家庭等了二十年才等到正義。)
He framed his diploma and hung it above the desk in his first office. (他把畢業文憑裱框，掛在第一次租的辦公室書桌上方。)
Her student visa requires proof of funds, so she had to show bank statements covering a full year. (她的學生簽證需要財力證明，因此她必須出示涵蓋整整一年的銀行對帳單。)
Cosmic radiation poses a serious risk to astronauts on long space missions, which is why shielding is tested carefully. (宇宙輻射對長期太空任務的太空人構成嚴重風險，因此防護遮蔽都要仔細測試。)

meaning: adj. 可延伸的；可擴展的
example: The extendable handle makes the case easy to pull, even when it is packed for a long trip. (可延伸的拉桿讓行李箱容易拖拉，即使是為了長途旅行而裝滿也一樣。)
The region's annual abundance of heavy rainfall supports dense forests, but it also makes sudden landslides more likely. (這個地區每年豐沛的豪雨滋養茂密森林，卻也讓突發土石流更容易發生。)
Her senior supervisor encouraged her to publish the early findings, even though the data were still clearly incomplete. (她的資深主管鼓勵她發表早期研究結果，儘管資料明顯仍不完整。)

meaning: n. 混雜；舊雜貨 vt. 混雜
example: The faded old photographs were a jumble of happy holidays, weddings and faces she could no longer name. (這些褪色的老照片混雜著快樂假期、婚禮，以及她再也叫不出名字的面孔。)
The new clinic is equipped with reliable solar panels, so vaccines stay cold even during long power cuts. (新診所配備可靠的太陽能板，因此即使長時間停電，疫苗也能保持低溫。)
The dam caused permanent damage to the entire valley, and several small local villages were never completely rebuilt. (水壩對整個山谷造成永久破壞，幾個當地小村莊也一直未能完全重建。)
The tiny chip is embedded in the plastic card, which makes it nearly impossible for criminals to copy. (微型晶片嵌在塑膠卡片裡，讓歹徒幾乎不可能複製。)
The compulsory orientation week includes short campus tours, library training and a talk on academic honesty for new students. (強制參加的迎新週為新生安排簡短校園導覽、圖書館使用訓練，以及學術誠信講座。)
The dam deprived the village of water during the driest months of the year. (水壩讓這個村莊在最乾的幾個月裡失去水源。)
It amazed me that the tiny shop sold bread from six in the morning. (令我驚訝的是，那家小店從早上六點就開始賣麵包。)
The company paid a small dividend to shareholders even in a bad year. (即使在那樣不景氣的一年，公司仍發給股東一點股息。)
Given the choice, most passengers showed a clear preference for the window seats. (若有選擇，多數乘客明顯偏好靠窗的座位。)

meaning: n. 契約；合約 v. 縮小；簽約
example: The player signed a two-year contract, but a serious knee injury ended his season after only three matches. (這名球員簽了兩年合約，但嚴重的膝傷讓他的球季只打了三場就結束。)
She felt uneasy walking home alone after the street lights went out. (路燈熄掉後，她一個人走回家，心裡很不安。)
The door locks automatically at midnight, so remember to take your key. (這扇門午夜會自動上鎖，所以記得帶鑰匙。)

meaning: adj. 女性的；雌性的 n. 女性；雌性
example: The female engineers on the team designed a lighter frame for the bike. (團隊中的女性工程師設計了更輕的自行車車架。)
Her calm manner is a great asset when customers start to complain. (客人開始抱怨時，她沉穩的態度是一大優勢。)
The young athlete trains twice a day and still finds time to study. (這位年輕運動員每天練兩次，還能抽出時間讀書。)
For clarity, the map uses different colours for each type of road. (為了清楚起見，地圖用不同顏色標示各類道路。)
We easily agreed to swap weekly shifts so that she could still attend her sister's wedding in July. (我們很乾脆地同意交換每週班表，讓她仍能參加妹妹七月的婚禮。)

meaning: adj. 老練的；精密的；複雜的
example: The new camera is sophisticated, but the menu is hard to understand. (這台新相機很精密，但選單很難看懂。)
The bulk of the new funding actually came from local taxes, not from the national government as expected. (新經費的大部分其實來自地方稅收，而非大家原本以為的中央政府。)
Modern farm machinery has reduced the need for workers, although it still requires costly maintenance and trained operators. (現代農業機械減少了人力需求，不過仍需昂貴的維護和受訓過的操作員。)

meaning: adj. 親密的；私人的 n. 密友 vt. 暗示
example: Only a few intimate friends were invited to the small wedding ceremony. (婚禮辦得很小，只邀請了幾位親密的朋友。)
The hospital strictly restricts visiting hours so that elderly patients can rest, but close relatives often still complain. (醫院嚴格限制探病時間，讓年長病人能休息，但近親仍常抱怨。)
Carrying extra abdominal weight around the waist clearly increases heart risk, even in people of otherwise normal weight. (腰部囤積多餘脂肪明顯會增加心臟風險，即使是其他方面體重正常的人也不例外。)
The small firm hired someone of exceptional international calibre, hoping to quickly strengthen its already strong research division. (這家小公司聘用了一位具卓越國際才幹的人，希望迅速強化原本就很強的研究部門。)

meaning: adj. 嚴厲的；惡劣的；刺耳的
example: The winter here is harsh, with strong winds and very little sunlight. (這裡的冬天很惡劣，風大又幾乎沒有陽光。)
Parliament debated the new tax for three days before putting it to a vote. (國會針對新稅辯論了三天，才付諸表決。)
Our flight to Hong Kong was delayed for two hours because of heavy fog. (我們飛往香港的班機因為濃霧延誤了兩小時。)
The app gently reminds elderly patients to take their daily pills, which helps those who really live alone. (這款應用程式會輕聲提醒年長病人每天服藥，對真正獨居的人很有幫助。)
The small aquarium now successfully breeds rare seahorses, and some are eventually released into local protected coastal waters. (這座小型水族館成功繁殖稀有海馬，有些最後被野放到當地受保護的沿海水域。)
Each individual cell in the sample was carefully photographed, allowing researchers to clearly compare healthy and damaged tissue. (樣本中每個細胞都經過仔細拍攝，讓研究人員能清楚比較健康與受損組織。)
City dwellers often pay more for a single small flat than nearby villagers pay for an entire house. (城市居民買一間小公寓的錢，往往比附近村民買一整棟房子還多。)
The mayor declared the old riverside market a protected site last spring. (市長去年春天宣布舊河岸市場為保護區。)
My suitcase was so heavy that I had to pay an extra fee. (我的手提箱太重了，只好付額外費用。)

meaning: n. 畢業生 v. 畢業
example: Each university graduate receives career advice, and most find full-time work within six months of finishing the course. (每位大學畢業生都會獲得職涯建議，多數人在完成課程後六個月內找到全職工作。)
Economists failed to predict the sudden sharp global rise in food prices, which really hit local households hardest. (經濟學家未能預測全球糧價突然大幅上漲，這對當地家庭打擊最大。)
The charity's headquarters moved into an old former school, giving local staff far more space at lower cost. (這家慈善機構的總部搬進一所舊學校，讓當地員工以更低成本獲得更大的空間。)
The flood received little national coverage because another disaster filled the news. (那場水災報導很少，因為另一場災難佔滿了新聞版面。)
Officers enforce the parking rules strictly during the busy morning rush hour. (早上尖峰時段，員警嚴格執行停車規定。)
Dried persimmon is a local specialty that sells well in winter markets. (柿餅是本地特產，冬天在市場賣得很好。)
Teachers should value the intrinsic pleasure of reading for young pupils, not only the exam results it clearly produces. (教師應重視閱讀帶給年幼學生的內在樂趣，而不只是它明顯帶來的考試成績。)
Medical students now spend more time in local clinics, which gives them valuable practical experience before they qualify. (醫學生現在花更多時間在當地診所，在取得資格前獲得寶貴的實務經驗。)
Children carefully stick bright pictures on the classroom wall, and the display quickly changes with every new topic. (孩子們仔細把鮮豔圖片貼在教室牆上，展示內容隨著每個新主題迅速更換。)
Setting realistic monthly fitness goals matters far more than buying new expensive equipment you will probably seldom use. (設定實際的每月健身目標，比買昂貴的新器材卻大概很少使用更重要。)

meaning: adj. 漠不關心的；無關緊要的
example: The staff seemed clearly indifferent to our complaint, so we wrote a long letter to the manager instead. (員工對我們的抱怨明顯漠不關心，因此我們改寫了一封長信給經理。)
The large retailer stopped selling plastic shopping bags, and customers soon adjusted to bringing their own reusable ones. (這家大型零售商停止販售塑膠購物袋，顧客很快就習慣自備可重複使用的袋子。)
The shop's turnover doubled after it started selling coffee in the mornings. (早上開始賣咖啡之後，這家店的營業額成長了一倍。)

meaning: n. 品牌；商標 vt. 打烙印
example: This brand of tea is popular because it is cheap and easy to find. (這個品牌的茶很受歡迎，因為便宜又容易買到。)
Children under ten must be accompanied by an adult in the pool area. (十歲以下兒童在泳池區必須由成人陪同。)

meaning: v. 欺騙；作弊 n. 騙子
example: Students who cheat in university exams risk losing their place entirely, yet some still try despite clear warnings. (在大學考試作弊的學生可能完全喪失學籍，但有些人仍不顧明確警告嘗試。)
She mentioned the serious staffing problem twice, but the manager deliberately and quietly changed the subject both times. (她兩次提到嚴重的人手問題，但經理兩次都刻意悄悄轉移話題。)

meaning: n. 水平；等級 adj. 平的；同等的 v. 使平坦
example: The level of reading among new local pupils varies considerably, so teachers carefully group them into three ability levels. (當地新生的閱讀程度差異很大，因此教師依能力仔細把他們分成三組。)
Creative lateral thinking helps teams solve difficult problems that routine methods cannot address, especially under sudden time pressure. (有創意的水平思考能幫團隊解決例行方法無法處理的難題，尤其是在突然的時間壓力下。)
The forest is so dense that sunlight barely reaches the forest floor. (森林太茂密，陽光幾乎照不到地面。)

meaning: v. 閃光；閃耀 n. 閃光燈
example: A sudden flash of lightning lit the whole valley for a second. (一道突如其來的閃電，把整個山谷照亮了一秒。)
We packed nuts and fruit as a snack for the long walk. (我們帶了堅果和水果，當作長途健行的點心。)
The simple soup was marvellous, and the freshly baked warm bread really tasted even better than it looked. (這道簡單的湯非常美味，剛烤好的溫熱麵包嚐起來真的比看起來更好。)

meaning: v. 出口；輸出 n. 出口；出口商品
example: The country exports heavy machinery to its neighbours, although domestic demand for those goods still remains surprisingly strong. (這個國家出口重型機械到鄰國，儘管國內對這些產品的需求仍出乎意料地強勁。)
The stadium held a minute's silence as a tribute to the local coach who had trained generations of young players. (體育場默哀一分鐘，向訓練過好幾代年輕球員的當地教練致敬。)
Inspectors closed the restaurant because its basic kitchen sanitary conditions were clearly far below the required legal standard. (稽查人員勒令這家餐廳停業，因為廚房的衛生狀況明顯遠低於法定標準。)
Researchers must submit their final proposals online by Friday, and late applications will normally not ever be considered. (研究人員必須在週五前線上提交最終提案，逾期申請通常一概不予考慮。)

meaning: n. 檔案；檔案室 vt. 存檔
example: The local newspaper's archive was digitised last year, making old reports easily available to anyone with internet access. (這家地方報紙的檔案室去年完成數位化，讓任何能上網的人都能輕易取得舊報導。)
The evidence for the remedy is still only anecdotal, so doctors cannot recommend it as a widely proven treatment. (這項療法的證據仍只是軼聞，因此醫師無法把它推薦為廣受證實的療法。)
He took notes in shorthand and typed them up after the meeting. (他用速記做筆記，會後再打成文字。)
Her memory for names is exceptional, even among people twice her age. (她記名字的能力異常出眾，連年紀是她兩倍的人也比不上。)
It is rude to answer your phone during a meal with guests. (和客人一起用餐時接電話，是很粗魯的行為。)
Work on the bridge will resume once the river drops to a safe level. (等河水降到安全水位，橋樑工程就會重新開始。)
A wooden bookrest on each desk keeps heavy volumes open, which helps students who need both hands free. (每張書桌上的木製閱書架能把厚重書本撐開，方便需要空出雙手的學生。)

meaning: adj. 原始的；簡單的 n. 原始人
example: The first farming tools were primitive, made from stone, bone and wood. (最早的農具很原始，是用石頭、骨頭和木頭做的。)
The traditional craft of making paper umbrellas survives in a few local families, though tourists rarely buy them. (製作紙傘的傳統工藝在幾個當地家庭中留存下來，不過遊客很少購買。)

meaning: v. 僱用；租用 n. 租用
example: We hired a car for three days to explore the coast at our own pace. (我們租了三天車，沿著海岸慢慢玩。)
Workers must always wear protective goggles when cutting sharp metal, since small flying fragments can easily damage the eyes. (工人切割尖銳金屬時必須戴護目鏡，因為飛濺碎片很容易傷到眼睛。)
The clinic sends simple daily text reminders, thereby significantly reducing the number of busy patients who miss appointments. (診所每天發送簡單的簡訊提醒，因此大幅減少了忙碌病人錯過預約的情況。)

meaning: n. 樁；股份；賭注 vt. 以……打賭
example: She quietly sold her stake in the successful start-up and used the money to open a small bakery. (她悄悄賣掉成功新創公司的股份，用那筆錢開了一家小麵包店。)

meaning: n. 駁船 v. 猛撞；闖
example: An old barge heavily loaded with recycled paper moved slowly along the canal, heading for the factory upstream. (一艘滿載回收紙的舊駁船沿著運河慢慢移動，駛向上游的工廠。)
She teaches aerobics at the community centre on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. (她每週二、週四晚上在活動中心教有氧運動。)
A low shrub near the gate hides the water meter from view. (大門旁的一叢低矮灌木把水表遮住了。)

meaning: n. 板條 vt. 用板條製作
example: One wooden slat on the bench was loose and pinched my leg. (長椅上一根木板條鬆了，夾到我的腿。)
Tenants should seek independent legal advice before signing a lease, especially if the terms seem clearly very unusual. (房客在簽租約前應尋求獨立的法律建議，尤其是條款明顯很不尋常時。)
The film is worth seeing for its cinematography, especially the desert scenes. (這部片光是電影攝影就值得看，尤其是沙漠那幾場戲。)
Everyone in the village contributed wood and labour to rebuild the school. (村裡每個人都捐出木材和勞力，協助重建學校。)

meaning: n. 想像力；想像的事物
example: The story shows a young child's imagination at its richest and strangest. (這個故事展現了孩子最豐富、最奇特的想像力。)
The child's chronic bronchitis improved after the family finally moved to a drier flat away from the motorway. (這家人終於搬到遠離高速公路、較乾燥的公寓後，孩子的慢性支氣管炎就好轉了。)
Regularly skipping meals can seriously exacerbate daily headaches, particularly in people who already habitually drink far too little water. (經常不吃飯會嚴重加劇每日頭痛，尤其是本來就習慣水喝太少的人。)
The serious intrusion into her online private messages caused distress, and the magazine eventually published a public apology. (她的線上私人訊息遭嚴重侵犯，造成極大困擾，雜誌最後刊登了公開道歉。)
The hospital suddenly cancelled non-urgent operations because so many staff were ill, which understandably angered many elderly patients. (醫院突然取消非緊急手術，因為太多員工生病，這讓許多長者病人理所當然地感到憤怒。)

meaning: n. 軟木塞 vt. 塞住
example: He pulled the cork out slowly so that the wine would not spill. (他慢慢拔出軟木塞，免得酒灑出來。)
The company lost sensitive personal customer data, and the incident was not properly reported publicly for several weeks. (這家公司遺失敏感的顧客個人資料，這起事件有好幾週都未妥善公開通報。)
The heavy buffalo pull wooden carts through the muddy fields, which is still common in parts of rural Asia. (沉重的水牛拖著木車穿過泥濘田地，這在亞洲部分鄉村地區仍很常見。)
There was insufficient time to cover the whole syllabus, so teachers quietly cut several topics from the course. (時間不足以教完整份課綱，因此教師悄悄刪掉課程中的幾個主題。)
The small grocery now delivers to nearby farms, which saves older residents an increasingly difficult long weekly journey. (這家小雜貨店現在送貨到附近農場，讓年長居民不必每週辛苦跑一趟長路。)
The air was so hot and humid that the hospital ward still felt uncomfortable, even with the windows open. (空氣又熱又潮溼，即使窗戶開著，醫院病房仍讓人覺得不舒服。)
The direct relation between pay and job satisfaction is still often far weaker than many experienced managers tend to assume. (薪資與工作滿意度之間的直接關係，仍往往遠比許多資深主管以為的還要弱。)
Patients can easily confuse two medicines that come in dangerously similar packaging, so the pharmacy now prints much clearer warning labels. (病人很容易把包裝危險相似的兩種藥品搞混，因此藥局現在印製更清楚的警示標籤。)
All written correspondence with clients is stored digitally, which makes it easier to quickly find relevant past agreements. (與客戶的所有書面往來都數位保存，讓相關的過去協議更容易快速找到。)
The fair allocation of scarce hospital beds depends on simple clear rules, not on who always complains loudest. (稀少病床的公平分配取決於簡單清楚的規則，而不是誰最會抱怨。)
Streaming services have entirely changed modern entertainment, allowing viewers to watch almost whatever they like whenever they want. (串流服務徹底改變了現代娛樂，讓觀眾幾乎隨時想看什麼就看什麼。)
She finally conquered her fear of heights and completed the difficult climb, though she needed several nervous rests. (她終於克服懼高症，完成了艱難的攀登，儘管途中緊張地休息了好幾次。)
The old decorations were stored in a box, and the children carefully hung them on the tree together. (舊裝飾品收在一個箱子裡，孩子們一起小心地把這些裝飾品掛到樹上。)

meaning: n. 獎賞；報酬 vt. 獎勵
example: A reward of five thousand dollars was offered for the missing dog. (有人懸賞五千元尋找那隻走失的狗。)
Each small larva spends months underwater before emerging as an adult dragonfly, which explains the surprisingly long delay. (每隻小幼蟲在水中待上好幾個月才變成成蟲蜻蜓，這說明了為何等了那麼久。)
She worked part-time throughout the demanding final semester, which taught her to manage an extremely busy weekly schedule. (她在繁重的畢業學期一路兼職，這教會她如何應付每週極度忙碌的行程。)
The pair raised four offspring, all of which stayed near the nest. (這對鳥養大了四隻後代，牠們都留在巢附近。)
Apart from occasional rain, the weather stayed dry for the whole trip. (除了偶爾下雨，整趟旅程天氣都很乾爽。)
The crater is now a lake, and visitors can walk around its rim. (那個火山口現在是一座湖，遊客可以沿著邊緣走一圈。)
When the power failed, confusion ensued and the concert started twenty minutes late. (停電之後現場一片混亂，音樂會因此晚了二十分鐘才開始。)
The guide instructed us to keep away from the edge of the cliff. (導遊指示我們不要靠近懸崖邊緣。)
The declaration was signed by both countries after months of quiet talks. (兩國經過數月會談後簽署了這份宣言。)
Working from home gives parents more flexibility over their daily family schedule. (在家工作讓父母在每天的家庭行程安排上更有彈性。)

meaning: adj. 本地的 n. 本地人
example: Native local speakers often use everyday expressions that textbooks completely ignore, so learners truly benefit from real conversations. (本地母語者常使用教科書完全忽略的日常表達，因此學習者能從真實對話中真正受益。)
The new tunnel brought genuinely significant benefits, cutting the journey for local commuters to the airport by nearly half. (新隧道帶來真正重大的益處，讓當地通勤族前往機場的路程縮短將近一半。)
Fan loyalty kept the small club alive during years of poor seasons, when many sponsors quietly withdrew financial support. (球迷的忠誠讓這家小俱樂部撐過多年戰績低迷的時期，當時許多贊助商悄悄撤資。)
The hotel provides shampoo and conditioner, but guests frequently complain that the tiny travel bottles are too small. (飯店提供洗髮精和潤髮乳，但房客常抱怨小巧的旅行瓶裝分量太少。)
The city significantly reduced speed limits near local schools, and serious accidents fell sharply within the first year. (市政府大幅調降當地學校附近的速限，嚴重事故在第一年內就明顯減少。)
The decision to close the school caused controversy, with parents divided over the benefits of a larger campus. (關閉學校的決定引發爭議，家長對大型校區的好處看法分歧。)

meaning: n. 服務；公共設施；維修 vt. 維修
example: The local ambulance service struggles to quickly reach remote farms, especially when heavy snow blocks the mountain roads. (當地救護服務很難迅速抵達偏遠農場，尤其是大雪封住山路時。)
Very few animals can dwell in such a dry and salty environment. (很少有動物能在這麼乾又鹹的地方棲身。)
A burning sensation in his fingers made him drop the hot pan. (手指一陣灼熱的感覺，讓他鬆手把熱鍋掉了。)

meaning: n. 碎屑；廢料 vt. 廢棄
example: Artists turned old scrap from the shipyard into colourful sculptures, which now stand along the public harbour promenade. (藝術家把造船廠的舊廢料變成色彩鮮豔的雕塑，現在矗立在公共港濱步道旁。)
Parents grow increasingly anxious when children miss curfew, even if the delay usually has a perfectly harmless explanation. (孩子超過門禁時間時，父母會越來越焦慮，即使延誤通常有完全無害的原因。)
The recipient must sign for the parcel before the driver hands it over. (收件人必須先簽收，司機才會把包裹交給他。)
The two samples looked clearly identical at first, but laboratory tests later revealed a slight chemical difference in composition. (這兩個樣本起初看起來明顯完全相同，但實驗室檢測後來發現成分上有輕微化學差異。)
The thick walls are made of local clay and straw, which naturally keeps the traditional house cool in summer. (厚牆由當地黏土和稻草砌成，讓這棟傳統房屋在夏天自然涼爽。)

meaning: n. 競爭者；對手 vt. 與……匹敵
example: The two cafes are rivals, yet their owners borrow sugar from each other. (這兩家咖啡店是競爭對手，但老闆們還是會互相借糖。)
Tropospheric ozone levels rise sharply during summer heatwaves, which seriously worsens breathing problems for already vulnerable urban residents. (對流層臭氧濃度在夏季熱浪期間急遽上升，嚴重惡化原本就脆弱的城市居民呼吸問題。)
The old lighthouse is the main attraction for visitors to this coast. (這座老燈塔是這片海岸最吸引遊客的景點。)
The old earthwork beside the railway clearly dates from Roman times, though few passengers notice it even today. (鐵路旁古老的土方工程明顯可追溯至羅馬時代，但即使到今天也很少乘客注意到。)
Tall reeds surround the whole pond, hiding it completely from the road. (高高的蘆葦圍繞著池塘，讓它完全從路上看不到。)
My first impression of the interviewer was consistently quite positive, although her later questions proved unusually direct and detailed. (我對面試官的第一印象一直相當正面，儘管她後來提出的問題異常直接而詳細。)
The local report horrified readers, revealing that children had often been working quietly in dangerous conditions for years. (這份地方報導讓讀者震驚，揭露孩童多年來常默默在危險環境中工作。)
The introduction clearly explains the author's main purpose, but it says little about the evidence actually behind her claims. (導言清楚說明作者的主要目的，但對其主張背後的實際證據著墨不多。)

meaning: adj. 緊密的；簡明的 vt. 壓縮
example: The small flat is compact but really cleverly designed, with useful storage built into every single available wall. (這間小公寓雖然簡約，但設計得非常巧妙，每一面可用的牆都設有實用收納。)
She politely enquired about the exact salary, but the interviewer said the details would be formally discussed later. (她禮貌地詢問確切薪資，但面試官說細節之後會正式討論。)
From Monday onwards, visitors must book an online time slot, which should reduce queues at the main entrance. (從週一起，參觀者必須線上預約時段，這應能減少正門口的排隊人潮。)
A short memorandum was sent to all staff about the new security code. (一份簡短的備忘錄發給所有員工，說明新的門禁密碼。)
The garden is rectangular, with a path running straight down the middle. (這座花園是長方形的，中間有一條筆直的小路。)
He needs to drink more water because his kidneys are not working well. (他需要多喝水，因為他的腎臟功能不好。)
From a health standpoint, fried food should not be eaten every day. (從健康的觀點來看，油炸食物不該天天吃。)

meaning: adj. 有療效的 n. 藥品
example: The plant was once thought to have strong curative properties, but careful trials later found no clear reliable effect. (這種植物曾被認為具有強烈療效，但後來的嚴謹試驗並未發現明確可靠的效果。)
The audience was predominantly young, though a few older couples sat at the back. (觀眾大多是年輕人，不過後面也坐了幾個年長的夫妻。)

meaning: n. 離合器 v. 抓緊
example: The clutch on the old truck slips whenever the road goes uphill. (這輛老卡車的離合器在上坡時會打滑。)
The new system combines daily bus and rail tickets, so passengers really need only one single convenient payment. (新系統結合每日公車與鐵路票證，讓乘客真的只需一次方便的付款。)

meaning: n. 圖表；海圖 vt. 記錄
example: The clear chart tracks monthly local sales, making it easy to quickly spot which products are suddenly losing popularity. (這張清楚的圖表追蹤每月地方銷售，讓人能快速看出哪些產品人氣突然下滑。)
Heavy traffic pollution near the school has seriously worsened children's asthma, according to a recent study by local doctors. (根據當地醫師近期的一項研究，學校附近的嚴重交通污染已大幅惡化孩童的氣喘。)
The bank will not accept the form without your signature at the bottom. (沒有你在底部的簽名，銀行不會接受這份表格。)

meaning: n. 場合；時機 vt. 引起
example: The memorable final was the only occasion this season when the home stadium was completely sold out well in advance. (這場令人難忘的決賽是本季主場體育場唯一提前完全售罄的場合。)
This water contains natural minerals that give it a slightly salty taste. (這種水含有礦物質，喝起來有一點鹹味。)
Her knowledge of the old land records was invaluable during the long search. (漫長的搜尋過程中，她對舊土地紀錄的了解非常珍貴。)
The town gradually recovered after the main factory closed, but new small shops eventually filled the empty streets. (主要工廠關閉後，這座小鎮逐漸恢復，新開的小店最後也填滿了空蕩的街道。)
Moderation in exercise is important at first, especially since suddenly doing too much can cause serious injury for beginners. (剛開始運動時適度很重要，尤其是突然做太多可能讓初學者嚴重受傷。)
Bring all the necessary documentation to the airport, including proof of insurance and a clearly printed booking confirmation. (把所有必要文件帶到機場，包括保險證明和列印清楚的訂位確認單。)

meaning: adj. 批判的；危急的；關鍵的
example: Early diagnosis is absolutely critical, since treatment clearly works far better before the disease spreads quickly to other organs. (早期診斷絕對關鍵，因為在疾病迅速擴散到其他器官前治療，效果明顯好得多。)
Vocational training gives young people valuable practical skills, yet many parents still strongly prefer traditional academic degrees for their children. (職業訓練賦予年輕人寶貴的實用技能，但許多家長仍強烈偏好讓孩子攻讀傳統學術學位。)

meaning: n. 摘要 adj. 概括的
example: The brief summary unfortunately omits several important findings, which makes the report potentially quite misleading to busy readers. (這份簡短摘要可惜漏掉幾項重要發現，可能讓忙碌的讀者對報告產生相當大的誤解。)
Surgeons successfully removed the small tumour, and the anxious patient was able to go home two days later. (外科醫師成功切除小腫瘤，焦慮的病人兩天後就能回家。)
The old coffer in the corner held documents nobody had opened for years. (角落那個舊保險箱裡的文件，已經好幾年沒人打開過。)
Some minor disagreement is always bound to arise when an entire small team changes its working hours suddenly. (當一整個小團隊突然改變工時，一些輕微歧見必然會出現。)
Old thermometers contain mercury, so they must not be thrown in the bin. (舊溫度計含有水銀，所以不能丟進垃圾桶。)

meaning: n. 小飾品；不值錢的珠寶
example: The market sells cheap colourful plastic trinkets, but few tourists really realise that most are actually made abroad. (這個市場賣廉價的彩色塑膠小飾品，但很少有遊客真正意識到大多數其實是國外製造。)
The current lease expires next month, so the tenants must quickly decide whether to renew or move again. (目前的租約下個月到期，因此房客必須盡快決定要續租還是再次搬家。)

meaning: adj. 可接近的；易到達的
example: The beach is accessible by a narrow wooden path suitable for wheelchairs. (這片海灘有一條適合輪椅的窄木棧道可以到達。)
Each offshore turbine is inspected regularly twice a year, which prevents small faults from becoming serious costly failures. (每座離岸渦輪機每年定期檢查兩次，防止小故障變成嚴重又昂貴的損壞。)
Community nurses often form the backbone of local rural healthcare, yet their pay still remains lower than that of hospital staff. (社區護理師往往是當地鄉村醫療的骨幹，但她們的薪資仍低於醫院員工。)

meaning: vt. 歸因於 n. 屬性
example: She attributes her good health to daily walking and a simple diet. (她把自己的健康歸因於走路和簡單的飲食。)
No one expected a sudden storm of this magnitude in early autumn. (沒有人料到初秋會有這麼大的暴風雨。)
This charger is not compatible with the older model of the phone. (這個充電器跟舊款手機不相容。)
The young entrepreneur started out by selling cakes from her own kitchen. (這位年輕創業者最初在自己廚房裡賣蛋糕。)
The proposal for a new car park was rejected at the public meeting. (新停車場的提案在公開會議上被否決了。)

meaning: n. 教練；長途巴士 vt. 訓練
example: The coach was unfortunately delayed by roadworks, so we missed the next ferry and waited two long hours. (長途巴士不幸因道路施工誤點，我們因此錯過下一班渡輪，等了兩個漫長的小時。)
The infection is now rarely fatal, but it can leave even very healthy patients weak for several months. (這種感染現在很少致命，但可能讓即使非常健康的病人虛弱好幾個月。)
The local currency lost value quickly, so prices changed almost every week. (當地貨幣迅速貶值，物價幾乎每週都在變。)
Many managers strongly disapprove of remote work, even though productivity has clearly risen since staff began staying home. (許多主管強烈不贊成遠距工作，儘管自從員工開始在家上班後，生產力明顯提升。)
Several guests complained that the air conditioning was too noisy, so the manager offered them a free night. (有幾位房客抱怨空調太吵，因此經理免費招待他們住一晚。)
The fact sheet beside the machine explains emergency procedures, yet few new staff bother to read it carefully. (機器旁的資料頁說明緊急處理程序，但很少新進員工願意仔細閱讀。)
Her audacious question surprised the whole panel, although it eventually led to a serious discussion about much-needed funding. (她那句大膽的提問讓整個評審團大吃一驚，不過最後也促成了關於亟需經費的認真討論。)
Heavy snow disrupted train services across the north for almost three days. (大雪讓北部火車班次中斷了將近三天。)

meaning: v. 跋涉 n. 長途跋涉；流浪漢
example: We tramped through deep snow for nearly an hour before a small wooden hut finally appeared ahead of us. (我們在深雪中跋涉了近一小時，前方才終於出現一間小木屋。)
Mice became a serious pest in the grain store, so farmers finally sealed every crack in the walls. (老鼠成了穀倉裡嚴重的害蟲，農民最後把牆上每道裂縫都封住。)
Inflation rose sharply last year, and everyday food became much more expensive. (去年通貨膨脹大幅上升，日常食物貴了許多。)
The police issued a brief statement confirming that the busy main road would stay closed until early Friday. (警方發表簡短聲明，確認繁忙的主要道路會封閉到週五清晨。)

meaning: n. 總額；數量 vi. 合計
example: A surprising amount of rain fell in just two hours, which flooded the lower streets of the town. (短短兩小時內降下驚人數量的雨，淹沒了小鎮地勢較低的街道。)
Under the given deadline, the team had to abandon two experiments and quickly publish only the strongest results. (在既定的期限下，團隊不得不放棄兩項實驗，只快速發表最有力的結果。)
This advanced software helps small farms predict rainfall, although many older farmers still trust their own experience more. (這套先進軟體幫助小農預測降雨，儘管許多老農仍更相信自己的經驗。)
Learning to swim was a milestone for the shy eight-year-old village boy. (學會游泳對這個害羞的八歲鄉下男孩是個里程碑。)

meaning: n. 曲柄 vt. 轉動曲柄
example: The iron crank by the well had almost rusted solid, so fetching water became a slow daily task. (井邊的鐵曲柄幾乎鏽死，因此打水成了每天緩慢的差事。)
A lexicographer must decide which new words deserve an entry, and that choice often strongly divides public opinion. (詞典編纂者必須決定哪些新詞值得收錄，而這個選擇往往強烈分化大眾意見。)

meaning: n. 束；串；群 v. 聚集
example: She bought a bunch of parsley and two lemons at the stall. (她在攤子上買了一把巴西里和兩顆檸檬。)
The dancers wore bright red costumes made of silk and tiny mirrors. (舞者穿著用絲綢和小鏡片做成的鮮豔紅色戲服。)

meaning: v. 驚嚇；害怕 n. 恐慌
example: The sudden noise scared the horses, and one of them bolted away. (突然的聲響嚇到馬匹，其中一匹還跑掉了。)
He manipulated the sales figures to make the loss look much smaller. (他操縱銷售數字，讓虧損看起來小得多。)

meaning: adj. 少年的；幼稚的 n. 少年
example: The centre runs classes for juvenile offenders who are learning a trade. (這個中心為正在學一技之長的少年犯開課。)
This phenomenon is common in large cities, where artificial light and late shifts keep millions of people awake. (這種現象在大城市很常見，人造光和夜班讓數百萬人保持清醒。)

meaning: n. 貨物；貨運 vt. 運送
example: The railway carries freight at night, when passenger trains are much fewer. (這條鐵路在夜間運貨，因為那時客運列車少得多。)
Elderly residents are especially vulnerable during heatwaves, so the council opens several cooled public rooms until well after midnight. (年長居民在熱浪期間特別脆弱，因此市公所開放幾間有冷氣的公共室到午夜過後。)

meaning: n. 蒸汽 v. 冒蒸汽；以蒸汽驅動
example: Dense steam from the huge kitchen pots filled the small room, making the summer working conditions almost unbearable. (大鍋冒出的濃密蒸汽瀰漫小房間，讓夏天的工作環境幾乎難以忍受。)

meaning: adj. 貴重的；有價值的 n. 貴重物品
example: The failed project taught us a valuable lesson about carefully checking costs before promising a firm delivery date. (這個失敗的專案給了我們寶貴的一課：在承諾確切交期前要仔細核對成本。)
The train was presumably delayed by the heavy fog, since no announcement was made at the crowded platform. (火車大概是因為濃霧誤點，因為擁擠的月台上沒有任何廣播。)

meaning: n. 聖地；庇護所；保護區
example: The old garden became a sanctuary for bees and butterflies after the council stopped cutting the wild flowers. (市公所停止修剪野花後，這座老花園成了蜜蜂和蝴蝶的保護區。)
The small press will bring out her second novel early next spring. (這家小出版社將在明年春初出版她的第二本小說。)
Simple games can make arithmetic less frightening for young school children, especially those who already openly dislike numbers. (簡單的遊戲能讓小學生不那麼害怕算術，尤其是那些已經公開表示討厭數字的孩子。)
The nurses' request for extra night staff was finally approved, though the change will only start next month. (護理師要求增加夜班人力的申請終於獲准，不過這項改變下個月才開始。)

meaning: v. 猛衝 n. 猛衝；破折號
example: She dashed across the road as the rain started to fall harder. (雨開始下大時，她衝過馬路。)
He refused the treatment because it caused severe side effects, and his family eventually accepted that difficult choice. (他拒絕這項治療，因為它造成嚴重副作用，家人最後也接受了這個艱難的選擇。)
The coarse sand along this beach is uncomfortable to walk on, yet it protects the dunes during winter storms. (這片海灘的粗沙走起來不舒服，卻能在冬季風暴時保護沙丘。)

meaning: adj. 不安全的；缺乏自信的
example: Many young migrants feel insecure about their accent, even when friendly colleagues clearly understand almost everything they say. (許多青年移工對自己的口音缺乏自信，即使友善的同事幾乎都聽得懂他們說的話。)
The table was covered with a white linen cloth for the wedding. (婚禮時桌上鋪著白色亞麻桌布。)
Her designs take their inspiration from the shapes of leaves and shells. (她的設計從葉片和貝殼的形狀取得靈感。)
A generous neighbour lent us her family car for the whole weekend. (一位慷慨的鄰居把家裡的車借我們用整個週末。)
Farmers here cultivate rice on very narrow stone terraces built centuries ago. (這裡的農民在數百年前砌成的狹窄石梯田上種稻。)

meaning: n. 活動；戰役 vi. 從事活動
example: The campaign against single-use plastic began in one school, but it soon spread to shops across the entire district. (反對一次性塑膠的活動從一所學校開始，但很快擴展到全區的商店。)
Doctors warn that this eating disorder often begins quietly, and that early support greatly improves a patient's chance of recovery. (醫師警告，這種飲食失調往往悄悄開始，而及早的支持能大幅提高病人康復的機會。)

meaning: vt. 發現；認出 n. 地點；斑點
example: From the hill we spotted a herd of deer near the river. (從山上我們發現河邊有一群鹿。)
Nobody could predict the outcome of the vote until the last minute. (直到最後一刻，沒有人能預測表決結果。)
Burning garden waste can easily aggravate local air pollution, particularly on still autumn days when smoke hangs low. (燃燒庭園廢棄物很容易加重當地空氣污染，尤其是在煙霧低垂的無風秋日。)
The advertisement was a clever deception, promising free repairs that actually cost customers a large hidden monthly fee. (這則廣告是巧妙的欺騙，號稱免費維修，實際上卻讓顧客每月多付一大筆隱藏費用。)
A short break can sharpen your attention, although it will not replace proper sleep before an important exam. (短暫休息能讓注意力更敏銳，但它無法取代重要考試前的充足睡眠。)
The course is practical rather than theoretical, so students spend most mornings repairing real engines in the workshop. (這門課重實作而非理論，因此學生大多數上午都在工坊裡修理真實引擎。)
Young willow branches are pliable enough to bend without breaking, which is why gardeners shape them carefully each spring. (年輕柳枝夠柔軟，可以彎曲而不折斷，因此園丁每年春天都小心地為它們塑形。)
Proper disposal of food waste reduces methane, yet many restaurants still send everything to the ordinary rubbish bin. (妥善處理廚餘能減少甲烷，但許多餐廳仍把所有東西丟進一般垃圾桶。)

meaning: n. 子公司 adj. 次要的；附屬的
example: The bank closed its local subsidiary and moved the staff to Taipei. (銀行關掉本地子公司，把員工調到台北。)
Be cautious with that ladder, because its left leg is slightly bent. (用那個梯子要小心，因為左邊的腳稍微彎了。)

meaning: n. 模式；樣式 vt. 使形成
example: The tiles form a pattern of blue stars on a white background. (磁磚在白底上排成藍色星星的樣式。)
The terrain is steep and rocky, so the walk takes longer than expected. (地形陡峭又多岩石，所以這段路走起來比預期久。)
He developed the photographs in a small darkroom behind the camera shop. (他在相機店後面的小暗房裡沖洗照片。)
She had to kneel to reach the jars at the back of the shelf. (她得跪下來才搆得到層架後面的玻璃罐。)
The amount of paperwork nearly overwhelmed him during his first week at work. (上班第一週，堆積如山的文件幾乎讓他不知所措。)
She looked at the broken fence with quiet contempt and said nothing. (她靜靜地輕蔑看著破掉的圍籬，什麼也沒說。)
I hardly recognized the square after they removed all the old trees. (他們把老樹全移走後，我幾乎認不出這個廣場。)
A small badge on his jacket showed that he worked at the local factory. (他外套上的小徽章顯示他在本地工廠工作。)
Many young people leave for economic reasons, even though their home town offers a quieter and cheaper life. (許多年輕人基於經濟理由離開，儘管家鄉提供更安靜、更便宜的生活。)
The old lamp gave a feeble light, barely enough to read by. (那盞舊燈發出微弱的光，幾乎不夠看書。)
Honesty is a quiet virtue, but it becomes surprisingly rare when a small lie could save someone embarrassment. (誠實是種安靜的美德，但當一個小謊能讓人免於尷尬時，它竟變得異常罕見。)
Beans are a good source of fibre and are cheap to cook. (豆類是很好的纖維來源，煮起來也便宜。)
They moved to a quiet suburb where the children could play outside. (他們搬到安靜的郊區，孩子可以在戶外玩。)
The machine pulverises the rocks into fine dust within a few minutes. (這台機器幾分鐘內就把石頭碾成細粉。)
Inductive reasoning moves from many small observations to a single general rule. (歸納推理是從許多細微觀察導向單一通則。)
Gardeners should fertilise the lawn in autumn, since spring feeding often encourages weak growth and more unwanted weeds. (園丁應在秋天為草坪施肥，因為春天施肥常助長孱弱的生長和更多雜草。)

meaning: n. 配給量；口糧 vt. 配給
example: During the war, each family received a weekly ration of sugar, butter and tea, and swapping items became common. (戰時每戶每週配到一份糖、奶油和茶，交換物品變得司空見慣。)
She finished university with a large debt, so she moved back home and worked two jobs for years. (她大學畢業時背著一大筆債務，因此搬回家住，並做好幾年的兩份工作。)
The job offered an attractive salary, yet the constant travel made it unsuitable for anyone with young children. (這份工作提供誘人的薪水，但頻繁出差讓有年幼孩子的人難以勝任。)
The conquest of space captured public imagination, although the enormous cost still deeply troubles many ordinary taxpayers today. (征服太空曾激起大眾想像，儘管龐大的成本至今仍深深困擾許多普通納稅人。)
As a city sophisticate, he expected the rural fair to bore him, but the clever local crafts delighted him. (身為城市老練人士，他原以為鄉村市集會讓他無聊，但當地精巧的工藝卻讓他欣喜。)

meaning: v. 折斷；啪地關上；厲聲說 adj. 突然的
example: The old power cable snapped during the storm, leaving the whole village without electricity for two cold nights. (老舊電纜在暴風雨中斷裂，讓整個村莊連續兩個寒夜沒電可用。)

meaning: vt. 表達 adj. 特快的 n. 快車；快遞
example: Several parents expressed concern about the new timetable, so the school arranged a public meeting in the hall. (幾位家長對新課表表達擔憂，因此學校在大禮堂安排了一場公開說明會。)
The thief was easily identifiable on camera because his jacket had a large bright logo on the back. (監視器畫面中的小偷很容易辨認，因為他的外套背後有個又大又亮的標誌。)

meaning: adj. 名義上的；微不足道的
example: They pay only a nominal rent for the cottage, since the owner wants someone to keep it warm. (他們只付象徵性的租金住這間小屋，因為屋主希望有人讓屋子保持溫暖。)
Children acquire their first language naturally, without formal lessons, simply by hearing it spoken around them every day. (孩童自然而然習得母語，不需正式課程，只靠每天聽見周遭的人說。)
I bumped into an old classmate at the night market last Friday. (上週五我在夜市巧遇一位老同學。)
Graphology claims to reveal character through handwriting, but the evidence is very weak. (筆跡學聲稱能從字跡看出性格，但證據非常薄弱。)

meaning: v. 登記；註冊 n. 登記表
example: You must register the bicycle before you can take it on the ferry. (你必須先登記自行車，才能把它帶上渡輪。)
This extremely rare bird nests only on one small island, where access is strictly controlled by the wildlife authority. (這種極其罕見的鳥只在一個小島築巢，島上出入由野生動物主管機關嚴格管制。)

meaning: v. 腐爛 n. 腐爛
example: The fruit began to rot after two days in the warm kitchen. (水果放在溫暖的廚房兩天後就開始腐爛。)
An ambulance arrived within ten minutes and took the injured cyclist to hospital. (救護車十分鐘內就到，把受傷的單車騎士送到醫院。)
The cold rain made the whole camping trip miserable for everyone there. (冰冷的雨讓在場每個人的整趟露營都很痛苦。)
A continuous low hum from the factory kept us awake all night. (工廠連續不斷的低鳴讓我們整夜睡不著。)

meaning: v. 分開；分配；除以 n. 分歧；分界線
example: The new policy divided the staff, with younger teachers welcoming it and older ones demanding more formal consultation. (新政策讓教職員分裂，年輕教師歡迎它，較資深的則要求更正式的協商。)
The film earned a gross income of ten million dollars in its first week. (這部片第一週的總收入達一千萬美元。)
Leave your wet coat in the cloakroom before you go upstairs to eat. (上樓用餐前，把溼外套放在衣帽間。)
A short-term contract suits her perfectly at the moment, because she plans to travel abroad for several months next spring. (短期合約目前對她再合適不過，因為她打算明年春天出國旅行幾個月。)
His refusal to answer the question made everyone at the table uneasy. (他拒絕回答問題，讓餐桌上的每個人都覺得不自在。)
She cut the coupon from the magazine and used it at the shop. (她從雜誌剪下優惠券，拿去店裡使用。)
The lawyer consulted a dusty tome on property law, searching for a single sentence that might help her client. (律師翻查一本布滿灰塵的房地產法巨著，尋找可能幫到當事人的某一句話。)
This toxin can survive thorough cooking, so reheating the spoiled rice will not make it safe to eat. (這種毒素經得起徹底烹煮，因此把壞掉的飯重新加熱也不會變得安全。)
The two conferences were held simultaneously in different halls, forcing journalists to choose which sessions they could actually attend. (兩場研討會在不同廳同時舉行，迫使記者必須選擇真正能參加的場次。)
It seemed ridiculous to carry an umbrella on such a clear day. (這麼晴朗的天氣還帶傘，似乎很荒謬。)

meaning: n. 碎片；晶片 v. 削下碎片
example: A small chip of paint fell from the ceiling, and the landlord promised to repair the roof before winter. (一小片油漆從天花板落下，房東承諾在冬天前修好屋頂。)

meaning: v. 擦亮；潤飾 n. 亮光劑
example: He polished his shoes carefully before the interview, hoping that a tidy appearance would create a good impression. (面試前他仔細擦亮鞋子，希望整潔的外表能留下好印象。)

meaning: v. 想知道；納悶 n. 驚奇；奇蹟
example: I wonder why the council chose that expensive design, when a simpler one would have cost far less. (我想知道市公所為何選擇那個昂貴的設計，明明更簡單的方案會便宜得多。)
The new scholarship supports rural students who would otherwise be unable to afford university accommodation in the city. (這筆新獎學金幫助鄉村學生，否則他們負擔不起城市的大學宿舍費用。)
New employees spend a week familiarising themselves with the complex software before they handle any real customer accounts. (新員工會花一週熟悉這套複雜軟體，之後才處理真實的客戶帳戶。)
Life expectancy has fallen in some regions, which experts link to poor diet and limited access to doctors. (部分地區的平均壽命下降，專家將其歸因於飲食不佳與就醫管道有限。)
Her grandmother saved every shilling carefully, yet she always found enough money to buy books for the children. (她的祖母每一先令都仔細存下，卻總能找到足夠的錢幫孩子買書。)
